papers.abstract: World models enable embodied agents to anticipate action consequences, yet jointly modeling locomotion and manipulation across diverse embodiments remains challenging due to heterogeneous action spaces and limited multimodal supervision. We present Ropedia W0, the first egocentric loco-manipulation world foundation model spanning humans and robots with diverse embodiments. We curate Xp-Data, comprising 10k hours of egocentric human data and 3k hours of robot data with unified multimodal annotations and systematic quality control. A unified kinematic representation encodes locomotion through camera poses and manipulation through projected skeletons, with robot skeletons combining embodiment-specific forward kinematics with extensive manual keypoint annotation and correction. We also introduce Xp-Teleop, a long-horizon loco-manipulation benchmark based on high-quality dexterous humanoid teleoperation data. Evaluations demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across five cross-embodiment benchmarks (DreamDojo, $\Psi_0$, $\omega$-HOME, Xp-Teleop, and AgiBot) and on held-out human egocentric video, from zero-shot inference to few-shot and full-data post-training. Scaling human pre-training data improves performance on both human and robot evaluations. After distillation, our model supports real-time, minute-long rollouts, enabling live VR interaction. Applications in policy evaluation, model-based planning, and world-action modeling further demonstrate the model's utility for embodied decision-making.

analysis.key_results: 在五个跨实体基准（DreamDojo、Ψ0、ω-HOME、Xp-Teleop、AgiBot）上取得最先进性能，并展示了零样本、少样本及全数据后训练效果；蒸馏后支持实时分钟级推演。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出首个以自我为中心的运动-操纵世界基础模型Ropedia W0，能够跨人类和机器人实体进行动作后果预测，并发布统一的多模态数据集Xp-Data和基准Xp-Teleop。
analysis.method: 构建包含10k小时人类自我中心数据和3k小时机器人数据的Xp-Data数据集，采用统一运动学表示（相机姿态编码运动、投影骨架编码操纵），并通过蒸馏实现实时长期推演。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出首个以自我为中心的运动-操纵世界基础模型Ropedia W0，利用人类和机器人数据实现跨实体预测。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接聚焦于世界动作模型（WAM），明确联合建模运动与操纵，提出跨实体世界基础模型，并强调在世界动作建模中的应用，属于WAM核心研究。

figures.caption: Xp-Data curation pipeline. Heterogeneous human and robot recordings pass through five stages. (1) Data sources : 14 public human egocentric datasets, 6,000 h of in-house four-camera recordings, and 13 public robot datasets. (2) Video filtering removes low-quality or task-irrelevant clips with a vision-language model. (3) Multimodal annotation produces geometry (metric camera poses via SLAM and DA3 [ 69 ] ), kinematics (human hands via WiLoR [ 91 ] and MANO [ 96 ] , robot keypoints via URDF forward kinematics, manual annotation, and correction), and semantics (hierarchical task, subtask, and atomic-action captions). (4) Quality check verifies completeness, correctness, and cross-modal consistency, pairing automated checks with a caption cascade (Gemini [ 25 ] annotation, Qwen [ 6 ] verification, and human review). (5) Training-clip construction cuts quality-verified subtasks into standardized 81-frame, 640 × 480 640\times 480 , 16 fps multimodal clips, yielding the unified cross-embodiment corpus.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.title_zh: Ropedia W0：利用人类经验跨实体扩展运动-操纵世界模型

papers.abstract: Multimodal reasoning provides robotic foundation models with predictive context needed for reliable action generation. However, language-based reasoning captures task semantics but struggles to express fine-grained physical dynamics, while latent reasoning models future state evolution but offers limited structure for organizing these dynamics into reusable reasoning primitives. To bridge this gap, we introduce PhysWord, a reasoning-before-acting foundation model built on Physical Words, which use atomic action verbs as shared semantic anchors for continuous representations of physical dynamics. Specifically, PhysWord predicts upcoming atomic action words and directly aligns their contextual hidden states with latent targets derived from the corresponding future observations. Building on these primitives, we construct a temporally structured PhysWord space with visual and optional tactile variants of each action word. Autoregressively predicting Physical Words across future timesteps captures transitions between execution stages, providing structured multimodal context for action generation. PhysWord achieves state-of-the-art success rates of 90.3\% on visuotactile UniVTAC and 99.6\% on vision-based LIBERO-Long, and outperforms competing methods on real-world tasks using bimanual grippers and dexterous hands. Further evaluations demonstrate that our structured latent reasoning framework generalizes to unseen scenarios and enables long-horizon manipulation.

analysis.key_results: 在视觉触觉UniVTAC上达到90.3%成功率，在基于视觉的LIBERO-Long上达到99.6%成功率，并在使用双臂夹爪和灵巧手的真实世界任务上优于竞争方法。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出PhysWord，一个基于物理词（以原子动作动词作为连续物理动态表示的语义锚点）的推理前行动基础模型。
analysis.method: PhysWord预测即将到来的原子动作词，并将其上下文隐藏状态与由未来观测导出的隐式目标对齐；构建时间结构化的PhysWord空间（含视觉/触觉变体），通过自回归预测物理词来捕捉执行阶段转换，为动作生成提供结构化多模态上下文。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 论文提出PhysWord，一个基于原子动作词作为语义锚点来结构化隐式物理动态推理的机器人基础模型。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接相关：这是一个面向机器人操作的基础模型，将视觉、触觉和语言（原子动作词）结合，进行隐式推理并生成动作，属于VLA框架，并涉及世界模型思想（预测未来状态）。

figures.caption: PhysWord framework. (a) PhysWord connects temporal perception and reasoning-and-action branches through shared attention in a MoT architecture, generating Physical Words autoregressively before denoising actions. (b) The hidden states of visual and tactile Physical Word variants receive joint action-label cross-entropy supervision and cosine alignment with future sensory latent targets. (c) Physical Words use a blockwise-causal attention mask, with full attention within each end-effector’s timestep block, causal attention across its blocks, and no cross-effector attention.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.title: Physical Words: A Vocabulary for Structuring Latent Reasoning in Robot Manipulation
papers.title_zh: 物理词：机器人操作中结构化隐式推理的词汇表

papers.abstract: In this paper, we systematically investigate the mechanisms, scaling behavior, and generalization of physical Recursive self-improvement. We introduce PhysRSI-eval to quantify physical RSI through a five-axis metric: First-Attempt Performance, Efficiency, Success, Budget and Improvement from failure. Different VLMs are evaluated on 18 manipulation tasks under a fixed interaction budget. The analysis of experimental results motivates the Physical Barrel Hypothesis: different capabilities may constrain different parts of improvement. The five-axis metrics also distinguish systems with close public benchmark averages and show that high scores need not come with early or efficient gains. We study observational scaling from two perspectives: predicting the relative performance of VLM agents from their public capabilities, and forecasting later progress from early physical feedback. Together, these analyses ask how quickly and how far an agent can improve. Moreover, we conduct workspace interventions and then analyze what improvement leaves behind. Removing history reduces late-round success, frozen workspaces remain useful on unseen layouts, and three cross-task cases achieve success earlier. The results suggest that scene-specific adaptation and reusable experience can coexist.

analysis.key_results: 五轴指标能区分公共基准平均分相近的系统；高总得分不一定伴随早期或高效增益；移除历史会降低后期成功率；冻结工作空间在未见布局上仍然有用；三个跨任务案例更早达到成功；观察到场景特定适应与可复用经验可以共存。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出PhysRSI-eval五轴评估指标（首次尝试表现、效率、成功率、预算、失败改进），系统量化了视觉语言模型在18个操作任务中的物理递归自我改进能力，并提出物理桶假说（不同能力可能限制不同方面的改进）。
analysis.method: 在固定交互预算下，对多个视觉语言模型进行18个操作任务实验，利用五轴指标量化物理RSI；通过两个角度的观测性缩放研究（从公共能力预测相对性能、从早期物理反馈预测后期进展）以及工作空间干预实验分析改进机制。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该研究系统考察了视觉语言模型在物理递归自我改进中的机制、缩放行为与泛化能力，提出PhysRSI-eval评估框架和物理桶假说。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该研究以视觉语言模型作为机器人操作策略（LLM-as-policy），深入分析其在真实操作任务中通过失败反馈进行递归自我改进的能力，直接属于VLA与机器人操作策略学习范畴，对理解VLA的适应性、泛化性和改进动力学具有重要价值。

(Q2) Five-axis quantification and observational scaling of performance, gain timing and model rankings. T 50 T_{50} is the half-gain round, the first round at which the best mean score reaches half of its K1–K17 gain. (Q3) Overfitting and generalization across tasks and scenes.

Left, Evaluate (first-attempt round K0): one in-context episode of observe–reason–act through the shared tools, with no workspace; history and notes stay inside the episode. Right, Optimize (self-improvement rounds K1–K H H ): each round runs from a persistent workspace of skills, tools, policy and memory, is graded natively, revised with robot actions closed, and committed as the start of the next round, until the first native success or the round limit.

papers.title: Where is Physical RSI capability from? An Observational Scaling Law of LLM-as-policy

papers.abstract: Recent advances in multimodal models have enabled GPT-6 Astra to perform robotic manipulation through in-context learning. Yet contact-rich control and tactile perception are often regarded as strengths of specialist policies, leaving open whether Astra can directly understand and use tactile observations. We provide, to our knowledge, the first demonstration that Astra directly interprets vision-based tactile images and uses their contact cues for manipulation. Tactile RGB images enter through its existing visual interface, enabling few-shot closed-loop control on nineteen simulated UniVTAC and OpenViTac tasks with 210 sampled scene seeds per setting. With visuo-tactile input, Astra achieves mean success rates of 93.8% and 81.8%, exceeding the strongest reported specialist baselines in our comparison by 22.9 and 13.1 percentage points, respectively. Vision-only performance also leads these baselines, reaching 76.3% and 80.6%. Trajectory analysis reveals active probing, cautious grasping, contact-guided alignment, and recovery, alongside difficulties with tangential loading and corrective execution. Our findings challenge the exclusivity of specialist policies in contact-rich manipulation and show that fine-grained vision can partially compensate for missing touch. They also identify vision-based tactile sensing as an interface for scaling contact understanding with foundation models and reveal signs of benchmark saturation. These results motivate joint visual-tactile pretraining, harder contact-rich evaluations, and physical-robot validation.

analysis.key_results: 在视觉-触觉输入下，平均成功率分别为 93.8% 和 81.8%，比最强专用基线分别高出 22.9 和 13.1 个百分点；仅视觉输入也达到 76.3% 和 80.6%，同样领先基线。
analysis.limitations: 论文指出模型在切向载荷和纠正执行方面存在困难，并提到基准饱和现象，但摘要未明确说明具体局限。
analysis.main_contribution: 首次证明 GPT-6 Astra 作为通用多模态模型，能直接利用视觉触觉观测进行少样本闭环控制，并在接触丰富操作任务上超越最强的专用策略基线。
analysis.method: 将触觉 RGB 图像通过现有视觉接口输入 GPT-6 Astra，进行少样本闭环控制，并评估其在十九个模拟 UniVTAC 和 OpenViTac 任务上的表现。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文首次证明 GPT-6 Astra 能够直接理解视觉触觉图像并利用接触线索进行机器人操作，在多个模拟触觉任务上超越专用策略。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接研究 VLA（视觉-语言-动作）模型在机器人操作中的应用，特别是视觉-触觉多模态输入下的接触丰富操作，与本站主题高度相关。

Demonstrations and online interaction memory connect contact evidence to actions and outcomes. Astra generates end-effector and gripper commands; benchmark execution returns observations and a receipt for the next decision. The displayed fixed-camera and tactile images are actual inputs from Insert Hole, seed 1000028. Vision-only evaluation omits the tactile images throughout the context.

papers.title: GPT-6 Astra Is a Native Visuo-Tactile Policy for Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.title_zh: GPT-6 Astra 是用于接触丰富操作的原生视觉-触觉策略

papers.abstract: A seemingly reasonable push in Sokoban can make the puzzle unsolvable. To avoid such mistakes, an agent has to anticipate the consequences of its actions before execution, especially when feedback from the real environment is sparse or actions are irreversible. We introduce Agentic Imagination (Agima), a training framework that trains an agent to imagine before acting, i.e. to be imaginative. Agima trains a single omni model to propose actions, generate images of their outcomes, and then reason over these imagined futures to decide what to execute in the real environment. Rather than committing to a single plan, the agent can simulate a sequence of actions, explore alternatives, and compare possible futures. We first use supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to unify policy and world modeling within a single omni model. This enables the agent to predict future outcomes and perform basic forms of imagination, such as forward thinking and counterfactual branching. We then use agentic reinforcement learning (RL) to teach the agent to reason with its imagined futures and use them effectively for planning. Across four environments spanning Maze2D, Sokoban, Pacman, and PushT, Agima generalizes to harder settings unseen during training. Trained with SFT alone on two-box Sokoban, Agima solves 40% of four-box puzzles while seeing the real board only once every five moves, compared with an action-only planner that only solves 2%. After RL, new behaviors emerge in how Agima uses its imagination: it learns a new unified format that was unseen during the SFT stage, learns to conduct forward thinking only when necessary, and branches more frequently at critical decision points. An agent that can picture where its actions lead can learn when and where to look ahead, that is, to plan. Project page: https://agima.net/.

analysis.key_results: 在Maze2D、Sokoban、Pacman和PushT四个环境中，Agima在训练未见过的更困难设置下表现出泛化性；仅用SFT训练的双箱Sokoban模型在四箱问题上解决率达40%，而仅动作规划器只有2%；RL后出现新行为，如仅在必要时前瞻、在关键决策点更多分支等。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Agima训练框架，训练单一全能模型在行动前想象并推理行动后果，从而在稀疏反馈或不可逆动作环境中做出更优决策。
analysis.method: 结合监督微调统一策略与世界模型，再通过智能体强化学习训练模型利用想象进行规划。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出Agima框架，通过监督微调和智能体强化学习训练单一全能模型，在行动前生成并推理未来图像，以提升规划能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本工作直接涉及世界模型与策略学习的结合，训练模型根据行动生成未来视频画面并进行推理，可视为机器人世界模型与视觉-语言-动作模型的基础研究，但未明确涉及真实机器人或VLA架构。

(c) Planning with Agima in Sokoban: counterfactual branching rejects a deadlocking action, and forward thinking compares candidate plans before execution. The executed actions reach o t + K o_{t+K} , which grounds the next round of imagination. In (c), o ^ j \hat{o}_{j} is the predicted outcome of a ^ j \hat{a}_{j} .

papers.abstract: The goal of a world model is to capture the dynamics of an environment. This has the great appeal that it allows agents to plan and simulate a course of actions with the help of a world model. For these uses to be reliable, however, the learned dynamics must behave well beyond the specific state-action combinations observed in expert rollouts. Despite this, the relationship between data coverage, dynamics generalization, and downstream planning performance remains underexplored. We study this relationship through the lens of compositional generalization: can a world model recombine familiar state and action factors into valid dynamics? To answer this, we introduce AnyGoal, a benchmark of goal-shifted task variants built from widely used world-model environments, together with an open-source library. Each task is designed to be within reach of a world model that has learned the underlying dynamics: individual state factors and actions remain within their training support, but their combinations are underrepresented in expert trajectories. Across multiple environments and world model families, we find that current models consistently exhibit failures under these recombinations. By examining dynamics and representation failures across model families, interaction regimes, and evaluation metrics, we study where current world models generalize and where challenges remain for goal-shifted prediction and planning. Together, this framework, benchmark, and analysis provide a basis for evaluating progress toward world models that generalize to new planning tasks.

analysis.key_results: 当前世界模型在目标转移下的重新组合中普遍出现性能失败，在动态和表示层面存在泛化差距。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 AnyGoal 基准及开源库，通过目标转移任务变体研究世界模型的组合泛化能力，并指出当前模型在训练分布外重组时存在系统性能失败。
analysis.method: 构建目标转移任务变体，保持状态因子和动作在训练支撑内但组合在专家轨迹中欠表示，并在多个环境和世界模型家族上进行评估分析。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 通过组合泛化视角，研究世界模型在训练分布之外的动态预测与规划性能，并引入基准 AnyGoal 及开源库。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作针对世界模型的动力学泛化与规划能力，属于 WAM（世界行动模型）的评估范畴，为机器人世界模型的泛化性研究提供基准和方法借鉴。

A world model trained on Push-T performs poorly on Avoid-T, despite Avoid-T requiring only familiar 2D navigation and having individually familiar states and actions. In Push-T, action interventions reveal reduced model sensitivity in biased regions, suggesting that the model learns shortcuts rather than reusable dynamics.

papers.abstract: Existing world models can generate action-conditioned video from a single image. Many focus on camera movement, allowing users to explore the generated scene. However, navigation alone does not ensure that an action follows persistent rules when its outcome depends on state that is invisible in the current frame. We present Stateful Harness, a framework that separates world evolution from video rendering to support stateful and rule-governed interaction. It maintains an evolving world state under specified rules, renders each resulting event with a frozen video model, and uses the generated clip to update the world state for the next turn. At each turn, the harness resolves the action selected by the user and compiles the resulting event into an instruction, while a preview clip from an editable 3D scene provides spatial and camera guidance. To evaluate rule compliance, we build WorldState-Bench, a benchmark of 50 counterfactual twin pairs that share an initial frame and action but differ in hidden state and required outcome. Under rule-only prompting, the best of the 11 evaluated video backends produces the required endings for both cases in 32% of pairs. For MiniMax-H3, specifying the required endings raises this rate from 32% to 64%, while the full harness reaches 92% with the same frozen model. These results support separating rule execution from video rendering for world interactions with hidden state.

analysis.key_results: 在50对反事实孪生对的WorldState-Bench上，仅规则提示时最佳视频后端在两种情况下产生规定结局的比例为32%；MiniMax-H3指定结局后从32%提升到64%，完整harness达到92%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Stateful Harness框架和WorldState-Bench基准，证明将规则执行与视频渲染分离可显著提升隐藏状态下的规则遵循能力。
analysis.method: 分离世界演化与视频渲染：维护演化世界状态，用冻结视频模型渲染事件，再用生成片段更新世界状态；每轮解析用户动作并生成指令，用可编辑3D场景提供空间和相机引导。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出Stateful Harness框架，将世界状态演化与视频渲染分离，使动作遵循依赖不可见隐藏状态的规则。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作聚焦世界模型（World Model），处理动作条件视频生成中隐藏状态下的规则遵循问题，对世界建模和视频生成有直接贡献，但未涉及机器人动作预测、操作或VLA。

The harness executes predefined rules to determine the event before a frozen video model renders it, illustrated by the red and blue elemental states. The generated clip provides the visual anchor for the next turn.
figures.label: Figure 1

In the illustrated failure, an unwrapped video model opens the chest in both cases, violating the rule when no key is available. The harness maintains semantic and spatial state, executes the shared rule to determine whether the chest remains locked or opens, and renders each outcome with the same frozen video model.

papers.title: State World Models: Execute the Rules, Generate the Pixels
papers.title_zh: 状态世界模型：执行规则，生成像素

papers.abstract: Egocentric video supports diverse applications, including robot learning, augmented reality, and human activity understanding. Recovering metric 3D hand trajectories from such video requires estimating both hand motion and camera egomotion to express the hands in a consistent reference frame. Many existing pipelines recover hand and camera motion in separate stages, combining hand detection, hand reconstruction, camera tracking, and trajectory refinement. We present V-JEPA Hand, a simple feed-forward video model that jointly reconstructs bilateral hand motion and camera motion from egocentric clips. It uses a self-supervised V-JEPA 2.1 encoder to extract spatio-temporal features from full-frame video and a query-based predictor to decode these features into per-frame hand poses, hand presence, and camera motion. We use the predicted camera motion to express the hand trajectories in a common world frame. The model accepts known focal lengths or predicts them when unavailable. It reconstructs each clip in a single forward pass. We train both components end to end in a single stage on a mixture of diverse pseudo-labelled videos and high-precision 3D annotations. A single model achieves the lowest coverage-aware mean per-joint position error (MPJPE) among comparable baselines on ARCTIC, HOT3D, and EgoStandard. It also yields lower world-frame trajectory errors than the compared SLAM-based pipelines. Ablations support the benefits of video pretraining, temporal context, and mixed supervision. V-JEPA Hand achieves a forward-pass throughput of 93.4 FPS on a single RTX A6000. Project page: https://qft-333.github.io/V-JEPA-Hand-Page/.

analysis.key_results: 在ARCTIC、HOT3D和EgoStandard数据集上，单个模型在覆盖感知平均每关节位置误差（MPJPE）方面达到可比基线中最低；世界坐标系轨迹误差低于对比的SLAM基线；单张RTX A6000上前向传递吞吐量达93.4 FPS。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出V-JEPA Hand，一个简单的前馈视频模型，通过自监督V-JEPA 2.1编码器和基于查询的预测器，联合恢复双手运动与相机运动，并利用预测的相机运动将手部轨迹表达在统一的世界坐标系中。
analysis.method: 使用自监督V-JEPA 2.1编码器提取时空特征，基于查询的预测器解码出逐帧手部姿态、手部存在性与相机运动；模型端到端单阶段训练，混合使用伪标签视频和高精度3D标注；单次前向传递完成重建。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出V-JEPA Hand，一个自监督视频模型，联合重建第一视角视频中的双手运动与相机运动，以获取世界坐标系下的3D手部轨迹。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作虽未直接涉及VLA或WAM，但从第一视角视频中恢复世界坐标系下的手部运动与相机轨迹，属于机器人学习与具身智能中的世界建模和感知基础，可为机器人操作学习提供关键的状态估计与轨迹数据，与本站主题有一定相关性。

papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning enables learning high-performance control policies, but its reliance on extensive interaction limits deployment on physical systems where data collection is costly, and failures are unsafe. We introduce Prior-Informed Adaptation (PIA), an offline-to-online model-based RL framework that uses structured simulation priors for rapid adaptation. PIA pretrains a world model on heterogeneous low- and high-fidelity simulated trajectories, then adapts it with limited target-domain interaction using uncertainty-regularized planning. Rather than requiring an accurate simulator for policy transfer, PIA treats simulated trajectories as biased priors whose residual mismatch is corrected during online adaptation. We evaluate PIA in autonomous racing using high-fidelity simulation and on a real full-size autonomous race car. In simulation, PIA adapts faster across track and surface shifts than strong baselines, achieving lower lap times and fewer failures. On hardware, PIA achieves reliable few-shot adaptation with less than one hour of on-vehicle interaction.

analysis.key_results: 在自主赛车高保真仿真中，PIA 在不同赛道和表面变化下适应更快，圈速更低且失败更少；在真实全尺寸赛车上，PIA 在不到一小时的车载交互内实现可靠的少样本适应。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 PIA 框架，通过结构化仿真先验实现快速适应，无需精确仿真器即可在真实系统上少样本学习高性能控制策略。
analysis.method: 使用异构低保真和高保真仿真轨迹预训练世界模型，然后通过不确定性正则化规划在目标域有限交互中适应，将仿真轨迹视为有偏先验并在线修正残差失配。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出 Prior-Informed Adaptation (PIA)，一种离线到在线模型基强化学习框架，利用异构仿真轨迹预训练世界模型并通过不确定性正则规划适应目标域。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文聚焦于模型基强化学习和世界模型在自主赛车中的应用，与 VLA 或 WAM 主题无直接关系，但其世界模型预训练与适应方法可能对机器人世界建模有一定参考价值。

papers.abstract: Robotic manipulation in agricultural environments remains challenging due to variations in plant geometry, occlusion, and camera viewpoints. Pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) and generalist robot policies offer a promising approach to addressing these challenges by learning manipulation behaviors from multimodal observations and language instructions. However, adapting these policies to agricultural tasks requires domain-specific demonstrations, which are costly and time-consuming to collect on physical robots. In this work, we develop a simulation-to-real robot-learning framework for agricultural reaching and grasping that integrates task-specific demonstration collection and pretrained policy adaptation. A MuJoCo-based agricultural environment is developed with diverse tomato plant structures to support demonstration collection and controlled evaluation. Expert demonstrations are collected through joystick teleoperation, with a low-level controller used to execute robot actions. Two pretrained generalist robot policies, Octo and $\pi_{0.5}$, are adapted using simulated demonstrations, followed by further fine-tuning on a physical Franka Research 3 manipulator using real-robot demonstrations. The adapted policies are evaluated under in-distribution, viewpoint/spatial-shift, and out-of-distribution conditions in simulation, followed by physical-robot experiments. The influence of proprioceptive information on policy performance is also investigated. Results show that $\pi_{0.5}$ achieves higher task-performance scores than Octo and exhibits less degradation under distribution shifts. These findings demonstrate the potential of integrating pretrained generalist policies with task-specific demonstration learning for agricultural manipulation.

analysis.key_results: $\pi_{0.5}$在分布内、视角/空间偏移和分布外条件下均比Octo获得更高任务性能得分，且退化更小；本体感知信息对策略性能有影响。
analysis.main_contribution: 开发了一个结合MuJoCo仿真环境、遥操作演示收集和预训练通用策略（Octo和$\pi_{0.5}$）适应的仿真到现实框架，用于农业抓取任务。
analysis.method: 利用MuJoCo构建多样番茄植株仿真环境，通过操纵杆遥操作收集专家演示，使用低层控制器执行动作，并用仿真和真实机器人演示对预训练VLA策略进行微调。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出了一个仿真到现实的机器人学习框架，通过任务特定演示收集和预训练策略适应来实现农业场景中的抓取操作。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文核心涉及预训练VLA策略在农业机器人操作任务中的适应，属于VLA在真实机器人操作中的应用研究，与本站点VLA主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Smartphone GUI agents complete tasks in mobile apps by repeatedly reading the screen and asking a model for the next action. Mobile neural processing units (NPUs) enable local execution, keeping screen contents on the phone, but model latency accumulates with every action. Hybrid linear attention models reduce memory requirements, yet reusing their recurrent state requires checkpoints at the appropriate input positions. Agent requests retain instructions but rewrite recent history, so checkpoint policies designed for chat continuation can miss reusable prefixes. Retaining rollback states for speculative decoding can also move prompt processing off the NPU's matrix unit, adding overhead that outweighs decoding savings on short action outputs. A loaded model can further hold the NPU awake between tasks. We present Tandem, a runtime for hybrid GUI agents on mobile NPUs. Tandem saves recurrent state where consecutive prompts diverge, allowing later requests to reuse previously processed context. It keeps most prefill on the matrix unit and produces rollback states through a short per-token tail. Its verification kernel reads each weight block once for all proposed tokens. Between request bursts, Tandem releases NPU power votes without unloading the model. We implement Tandem in llama.cpp and evaluate it on recorded agent interactions across two Snapdragon generations. On a Snapdragon 8 Elite, Tandem reduces per-step latency by 30% for text-based screen descriptions and 16% for screenshots relative to llama.cpp's fastest NPU configuration, reduces energy per text step by 33%, and lowers standby power with the model loaded from 0.76 to 0.22 W.

analysis.key_results: 在Snapdragon 8 Elite上，与llama.cpp最快的NPU配置相比，Tandem将基于文本的屏幕描述的每步延迟降低30%，截图场景降低16%，文本步骤能耗降低33%，并将在模型加载时的待机功耗从0.76W降低到0.22W。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Tandem运行时，用于在移动NPU上高效服务混合线性注意力GUI代理，通过及时的循环状态保存、矩阵单元上的预填充和逐令牌回滚状态生成来降低每步延迟和能耗。
analysis.method: Tandem保存连续提示分歧处的循环状态以重用已处理的上下文；将大部分预填充保持在矩阵单元上，并通过短的逐令牌尾部生成回滚状态；验证内核为所有提议的令牌只读取一次权重块；在请求突发之间释放NPU功率投票而不卸载模型。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: Tandem是一个针对混合线性注意力GUI代理的移动NPU运行时，通过重用循环状态和优化自适应解码来降低延迟和能耗。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于移动NPU上的高效GUI代理推理，属于投机解码和高效推理范畴，未直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人动作世界建模。

figures.caption: Workload-driven serving challenges for mobile GUI agents. Each step observes the screen and generates an action. (a) Consecutive prompts share a prefix but diverge in recent history or screen content, making chat-oriented checkpoints poorly placed. (b) Short outputs provide few opportunities to amortize the prefill overhead of speculative rollback states. Tandem retains matrix-based prefill and uses a short recurrent tail. (c) Between tasks, active NPU power requests can waste energy even when the model remains idle. Tandem releases these requests without unloading the model.
figures.label: Figure 1

papers.title: Tandem: Serving Hybrid Linear-Attention GUI Agents on Mobile NPUs

papers.abstract: Humanoid robots hold great promise as general-purpose agents in human-centered environments, yet adapting generalist vision-language-action (VLA) policies to real-world humanoid loco-manipulation remains challenging. Unlike fixed-base or wheeled manipulators, humanoids must coordinate locomotion, posture, gaze, and dual-arm manipulation over a high-dimensional whole-body action space, where inaccurate base or waist motions can easily induce unstable and aggressive upper-body compensation. We propose HAF-VLA, a hierarchical action-flow framework for humanoid VLA control. Built upon a pretrained flow-matching VLA, HAF-VLA inherits the vision-language prefix encoder and action expert weights, and adapts them to humanoid whole-body loco-manipulation with learnable stage embeddings and cross-stage KV-cache conditioning. Instead of generating the full action chunk in a single pass, HAF-VLA progressively denoises a shared whole-body action space: first locomotion and head commands, then waist refinement, and finally full-body manipulation. To preserve structural dependencies across stages, we introduce a cross-stage KV cache conditioning mechanism, enabling subsequent action generation stages to refine and augment their outputs based on the action representations from preceding stages. Experimental results across six real-world tasks demonstrate that our framework significantly enhances the performance of existing models in humanoid loco-manipulation tasks, demonstrating an effective pathway for adapting strong mobile-manipulation VLAs to humanoid whole-body loco-manipulation.

analysis.key_results: 在六项真实世界任务上，显著提升了现有人形机器人移动操作模型的性能。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出HAF-VLA，一种分层动作流框架，用于将通用VLA策略适配到人形机器人移动操作，包括可学习阶段嵌入和跨阶段KV缓存条件化机制，以在共享全身动作空间中分阶段生成动作。
analysis.method: 基于预训练流匹配VLA，继承视觉语言前缀编码器和动作专家权重；采用层级式阶段去噪（先移动与头部命令，再腰部细化，最后全身操作），并引入跨阶段KV缓存条件化以保持阶段间结构依赖性。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出HAF-VLA框架，将预训练流匹配VLA适配到人形机器人全身移动操作，通过分阶段动作去噪和跨阶段KV缓存条件化解决高维全身动作生成中的稳定性与协调问题。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 与VLA高度相关：论文直接针对人形机器人的视觉-语言-动作策略适配，涉及全身动作空间的分层生成与控制，属于机器人动作预测与策略学习的核心主题。

papers.abstract: Block diffusion drafters accelerate speculative decoding by generating multiple draft tokens in a single forward pass. However, each pass produces only a fixed-length block from a single target-generated anchor, limiting how far the draft can extend. Meanwhile, target verification computes hidden states even at positions beyond the first rejection, but these states are typically discarded rather than reused. We propose ReAnchor, a training-free method that reanchors a pretrained drafter at shifted positions using discarded verifier states to generate parallel draft blocks. These blocks improve predictions within the original block and extend coverage beyond its endpoint. At sampling temperature of T=0, ReAnchor achieves its largest average gains on Gemma 4-12B, improving acceptance length by 19.4% and decoding speed by 17.9% across eight benchmarks. Averaged equally over four target models and eight benchmarks, it improves acceptance length by 15.2% and decoding speed by 13.4% with pretrained DFlash drafters.

analysis.key_results: 在采样温度T=0时，在Gemma 4-12B上平均接受长度提升19.4%，解码速度提升17.9%（八个基准）；在四个目标模型和八个基准上平均接受长度提升15.2%，解码速度提升13.4%（使用预训练DFlash草稿器）。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出无训练的ReAnchor方法，通过重用验证器在前一个草稿块中被拒绝位置后的隐藏状态，将预训练扩散草稿器重新锚定在移位位置，并行生成多个草稿块，从而改进预测并延长草稿范围。
analysis.method: 在扩散草稿器的基础上，利用被丢弃的验证器隐藏状态作为锚点，将草稿器重新锚定在移位位置；并行生成额外草稿块，扩展原始块内预测和块外覆盖；无需训练。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出无训练的ReAnchor方法，通过重用被丢弃的验证器隐藏状态将预训练扩散草稿器重新锚定在不同位置，并行生成草稿块以提升接受长度和解码速度。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文研究独立的推测解码效率优化，与VLA/WAM或机器人世界模型无直接关系；但其方法可潜在地加速任何基于自回归解码的模型，包括VLA或WAM中的语言/动作解码器。

papers.title: ReAnchor: Reusing Rejected Verifier States for Diffusion Drafting
papers.title_zh: ReAnchor：利用被拒绝的验证器状态重新锚定扩散草稿器

papers.abstract: Latent memory is gaining ground as a lightweight history supplement for GUI agents. It supplies history to a frozen vision-language model via prefix vectors trained with step-wise cross-entropy (CE). While resulting gains are naturally attributed to encoded history, our controlled experiments show they primarily stem from action revision. The prefix learns to alter the model's default actions. However, this revision is unscoped because step-wise CE pushes outputs toward reference actions at every step without explicitly preserving correct decisions. Consequently, it repairs errors but also breaks 8-13% of initially correct answers. Overall accuracy metrics hide these losses. We therefore propose ScopeMem, a latent-memory method for scoped revision. Its encoder conditions prefix generation on the model's initial answer and is trained to correct errors while preserving correct decisions. On the controlled ablation set, ScopeMem reduces the share of broken correct decisions to 5.6% while repairing more errors than any evaluated CE-trained prefix. On AndroidControl, GUI-Odyssey, and zero-shot AITW, ScopeMem outperforms all evaluated prompting and latent-memory baselines, enabling a frozen Qwen3-VL-8B to match or surpass GUI-specialized agents and Qwen3-VL-32B.

analysis.key_results: 在受控消融集上，ScopeMem 将正确决策被破坏的比例降至 5.6%，同时修复的错误数量优于所有 CE 训练前缀；在 AndroidControl、GUI-Odyssey 和零样本 AITW 上超越所有评估的提示和潜在记忆基线，使冻结 Qwen3-VL-8B 达到或超过 GUI 专用智能体和 Qwen3-VL-32B 的性能。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 ScopeMem，一种学习修订范围的潜在记忆方法，其编码器根据模型初始答案生成前缀，训练时纠正错误同时保留正确决策，解决了 CE 训练前缀因无范围修订而破坏正确动作的问题。
analysis.method: ScopeMem 编码器以模型初始答案为条件生成前缀；训练目标是在修正错误动作的同时保留正确决策。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: ScopeMem 提出一种潜在记忆方法，通过控制前缀生成范围，在修正冻结视觉语言模型（GUI 智能体）的错误动作的同时保留正确决策。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于 GUI 智能体的潜在记忆与高效推理，不直接涉及机器人或世界模型。但其核心思想——在冻结视觉语言模型中学习何时修订输出，保留正确预测——对 VLA（视觉语言动作模型）的高效推理和策略修正具有方法论参考价值。

Its 5.5-point accuracy gain (pp: percentage points) hides these harms. ScopeMem (right) learns to focus revisions on the actor’s errors, repairing 254 and harming 49.

The encoder E ϕ E_{\phi} 3 reads the first opinion, its confidence, the task and textual history to generate a prefix. This prefix is 4 prepended to the same context, and the actor 5 answers again. papers.title: ScopeMem: Latent Memory That Learns Where to Revise Frozen GUI Agents
papers.title_zh: ScopeMem：学习冻结 GUI 智能体修订范围的潜在记忆

papers.abstract: The limited onboard computing resources of robots make the inference demands of vision-language-action (VLA) models costly to accommodate. Reducing these demands through aggressive compression, however, can degrade manipulation performance beyond what supervised fine-tuning alone recovers. We present SPAR (Structural Pruning and Action Recovery), which simultaneously prunes the hidden and feed-forward intermediate dimensions of the large language model (LLM) backbone through pruning-aware tuning, then applies reinforcement learning (RL) to recover policy performance. Applied to $\pi_{0.5}$, SPAR reduces the language backbone from 2.34B to 0.09B parameters and the full model from 3.37B to 1.12B, removing approximately 96% and 67% of their parameters, respectively. At this compression level, RL raises average success across the four LIBERO suites from 84.55% to 93.45%, an 8.90-percentage-point gain. The compressed policy achieves a $1.98\times$ full-policy inference speedup over the unpruned model. These results identify substantial intermediate-dimension redundancy and show that post-pruning RL can recover manipulation performance in compact policies.

analysis.key_results: 将语言主干从2.34B压缩到0.09B，完整模型从3.37B压缩到1.12B；在四个LIBERO套件上平均成功率从84.55%提升到93.45%，推理速度提升1.98倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出SPAR方法，对VLA模型π0.5进行结构剪枝和剪枝感知微调，并利用强化学习恢复策略性能，实现了大幅参数压缩和推理加速，同时提高了任务成功率。
analysis.method: 结构剪枝与动作恢复（SPAR）：对LLM主干的隐藏维度和前馈中间维度进行剪枝，剪枝感知微调，随后使用强化学习恢复策略性能。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: SPAR通过结构剪枝和强化学习在保持操纵性能的同时大幅压缩VLA模型并提升推理速度。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的压缩与高效推理，属于机器人策略学习和高效推理的交叉领域，对部署高效VLA系统具有重要价值。

figures.caption: Overview of the SPAR Framework. Top: SPAR compresses the LLM backbone of a VLA policy, which integrates visual and language inputs to guide the action expert. Bottom: (1) Through pruning-aware tuning , SPAR jointly learns channel masks for the hidden dimension and the FFN intermediate dimension while adapting the policy to manipulation tasks. (2) These masks guide structural pruning , which removes inactive channels to form a smaller dense backbone. (3) After supervised fine-tuning of the compact policy, RL recovery further improves task performance through simulated interaction, updating the action expert and value head while keeping the pruned LLM backbone frozen.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.title: SPAR: Structural Pruning and Action Recovery for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.title_zh: SPAR：视觉-语言-动作模型的结构剪枝与动作恢复

papers.abstract: Human-collected robot manipulation data often mix successful behavior with retries, pauses, recoveries, and failures. Advantage-Conditioned Behavior Cloning (AC-BC) can exploit such mixed-quality data, but only if the conditioning signal is both accurately constructed from offline trajectories and effectively incorporated into the policy's action-vector-field prediction. Existing pipelines can weaken this signal by thresholding estimator-derived advantage scores into noisy conditions, and by routing conditions through prompts that weakly affect the action vector field. We introduce ALIGN, a condition-aligned AC-BC framework for vision-language-action policies. ALIGN directly predicts categorical pairwise conditions in the policy-facing label space and injects them into a DiT action expert through AdaRMS modulation fused with flow time. We evaluate ALIGN on deliberately mixed real-robot datasets for ARX X5 bowl stacking and Franka key hanging, each combining standard demonstrations with retry-heavy trajectories. ALIGN improves condition fidelity, strengthens conditional vector-field separability, and achieves 90.0% and 56.7% closed-loop success, compared with 56.7% and 33.3% for the strongest AC-BC baseline. These results indicate that aligning conditions from estimation to action prediction is an effective way to extract robust manipulation policies from data in which success, recovery and error coexist.

papers.abstract: While VideoLLMs have made significant progress in understanding short video benchmarks, they often struggle to summarize long-form ones. This is mainly due to performance degradation caused by long-context prompts, the inherent difficulty of preserving temporal continuity and a lack of semantically rich concepts in event descriptions. To tackle these issues, this paper introduces the first recursive Video Language Summarization Model (RVLSM) designed for video processing and tailored to long-form video-to-text summarization. RVLSM recursively decomposes videos into semantically coherent segments and delegates chunk-level reasoning to VideoLLM sub-models and external tools. It employs (1) Semantic Temporal Decomposition (STD), which preserves temporal coherence and continuity through a scene-aware chunking strategy that dynamically partitions videos according to semantic boundaries, and (2) Adaptive Multimodal Tool Calling (AMTC), which ensures semantic richness of the summary via a routing mechanism that selectively invokes auxiliary modules such as action recognition, optical character recognition, automatic speech recognition, and object detection. Experiments on the VideoXum and MixTyVSum benchmarks show that RVLSM consistently improves over zero-shot VideoLLM baselines across multiple model settings and performance metrics, and is competitive with a state-of-the-art fine-tuned model for video-to-text summarization. Importantly, the named entities in the RVLSM's summaries align more closely with those detected in the ground-truth summaries than those detected by baseline and state-of-the-art methods, confirming the saliency of the event descriptions it generates.

analysis.key_results: 在VideoXum和MixTyVSum基准上，RVLSM在多个模型设置和指标上优于零样本VideoLLM基线，并与最先进的微调模型竞争；RVLSM摘要中的命名实体与基准摘要的对齐更紧密。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出递归视频语言摘要模型（RVLSM），通过语义时间分解（STD）和自适应多模态工具调用（AMTC）实现长视频摘要。
analysis.method: RVLSM递归分解视频为语义一致的片段，将块级推理委托给VideoLLM子模型和外部工具，采用STD动态分区视频并调用AMTC路由机制选择性调用辅助模块。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出首个递归视频语言摘要模型，通过语义时间分解和自适应多模态工具调用，改进长视频到文本的摘要生成。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作针对长视频理解与摘要，属于视觉语言模型的高效推理，但不直接涉及机器人动作预测或世界模型，与VLA/WAM无直接关系。

papers.abstract: Every driving scene is logged once, but driving is one-to-many: the scene determines which behaviors are feasible, while an instruction selects among them. A log records only the action taken, leaving no direct supervision for alternative feasible actions or instructions the scene cannot support. Consequently, a policy that ignores language and one that follows it without regard to scene constraints can fit the same data. We present Cartender, which learns from the drives not taken. Counterfactual Branching constructs matched and mismatched instruction-action pairs from real recordings without a simulator: a vision-language model proposes alternative futures and their selecting instructions, while unsupported instructions provide negative labels. A learned scene-language compatibility score regulates language conditioning in trajectory generation, and a reward-trained language residual re-ranks generated candidates over a scene-based score. The branches are used for training; instruction following is evaluated by swapping instructions under identical recorded inputs and measuring behavior rather than agreement with generated targets. On WOD-E2E, the best of four proposals achieves an RFS of 8.642 across 3,603 feasible instruction conditions. Across 8,974 admitted proposals, mean RFS is 8.203 versus 7.906 for matched logged trajectories, and 67% score higher than their logged counterpart. Compared with matched-only imitation using the same backbone, Cartender improves same-scene paired instruction success from 23.67% to 57.00% and RFS from 6.32 to 7.10; its gate reduces infeasible-instruction execution from 53.36% to 14.18%.

analysis.key_results: 在WOD-E2E上，最佳提案在3603个可行指令条件下RFS达8.642；在8974个准入提案中，平均RFS为8.203，高于匹配记录轨迹的7.906，67%的提案得分超过其记录对应项；与仅匹配模仿相比，同场景配对指令成功率从23.67%提升至57.00%，RFS从6.32提升至7.10；门控将不可行指令执行从53.36%降至14.18%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Cartender，利用反事实分支从真实驾驶记录中构造匹配与不匹配的指令-动作对，并引入场景-语言兼容性评分和奖励训练的语言残差，提升语言条件驾驶的可验证性。
analysis.method: 使用视觉-语言模型生成替代未来轨迹及选择指令，不支持的指令作为负标签；学习场景-语言兼容性评分调节轨迹生成中的语言条件，并利用奖励训练的语言残差对生成候选进行重排序。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: Cartender通过反事实分支从未执行的动作中学习驾驶策略，实现可验证的语言条件驾驶。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接针对语言条件驾驶策略，属于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）范畴，但其核心贡献在于反事实数据构建和场景-语言兼容性建模，与VLA中指令跟随与场景约束的平衡问题密切相关，对本站主题有直接参考价值。

papers.abstract: Earth observation satellites acquire more data than they can downlink. Extracting information on board with artificial intelligence (AI) turns the satellite into a data-reduction stage that downlinks compact products, such as masks or detections, instead of full scenes; deploying it in a mission, however, involves the whole processing chain and not only the neural network. We present a generic on-board AI processing chain along three axes, with wildfire segmentation as the worked example among ship detection and cloud segmentation. (i) The AI model is tuned (spectral-band selection, input normalization), quantized to 8-bit integers (int8) and ported to an AMD Versal VCK190, with its excellent segmentation performance preserved on the board. (ii) A modular tiler-inference-mosaicer workflow, reused unchanged across applications, brings the tile-level model to scene level, turning a full acquisition into a scene-level mask or detection list. (iii) Each step is packaged as a unikernel and orchestrated on board by ORCHIDE, a cloud-native orchestrator. The chain is characterized end to end, from the standalone execution on the target to its execution under orchestration with parallel workflows on a representative test bench. Beyond AI inference on individual tiles, this approach aims at increasing the maturity of on-board AI deployment by addressing a complete processing chain, from the acquired scene to the mission-level execution.

analysis.key_results: 在板卡上量化后模型保持了优秀的分割性能，且在代表性测试平台上对端到端处理链和并行工作流进行了表征。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出并实现了一条通用的星载AI处理链，涵盖模型量化、场景级推理工作流以及基于unikernel和ORCHIDE的任务级编排，并通过野火分割、船舶检测和云分割三个应用进行了验证。
analysis.method: 将AI模型调优（波段选择、输入归一化）、量化为int8并移植到AMD Versal VCK190；使用模块化的分块-推理-拼接（tiler-inference-mosaicer）工作流将分块级模型扩展到整景；将每个步骤打包为unikernel并在ORCHIDE编排器下运行。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出了一条通用的星载AI处理链，将模型量化到int8并部署在AMD Versal VCK190上，通过模块化分块-推理-拼接工作流和unikernel编排实现端到端场景级处理，并以野火分割等应用为例进行验证。

papers.abstract: Modern robotic photography requires understanding photographic intent, planning camera motions, and producing aesthetically pleasing images in complex environments. We present RoboPhoto-VLA, a unified Vision-Language-Action framework that jointly models perception, reasoning, and camera control for autonomous robotic photography. RoboPhoto-VLA incorporates PhotoCoT for structured action planning and Aesthetic Direct Preference Optimization (ADPO) to align camera behaviors with human aesthetic preferences. To facilitate training and evaluation, we construct OpenPhotography, a robotic photography dataset with language-guided demonstrations. Extensive real-world experiments demonstrate that RoboPhoto-VLA produces photographs better aligned with human aesthetic preferences while generalizing effectively to unseen subjects, viewpoints, poses, and complex photographic instructions.

analysis.key_results: 真实世界实验表明，RoboPhoto-VLA能生成更符合人类美学偏好的照片，并有效泛化到未见主体、视角、姿态和复杂摄影指令。
analysis.main_contribution: RoboPhoto-VLA，一个统一的视觉-语言-动作框架，用于自主机器人摄影，整合摄影意图理解、运动规划与美学优化。
analysis.method: PhotoCoT结构化动作规划与Aesthetic Direct Preference Optimization (ADPO) 对齐人类美学偏好，并构建OpenPhotography数据集进行训练与评估。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出RoboPhoto-VLA，一个统一的视觉-语言-动作框架，用于自主机器人摄影，结合结构化动作规划和美学偏好对齐。

papers.abstract: Tool-using voice agents often leave users waiting after speech ends, even when actionable information arrives earlier in the request. Speculative approaches begin work during speech, but chunk-bounded or interrupt-on-update generation can truncate a tool call before its arguments are complete. This couples computation time to speech updates, limiting useful work completed in advance. We introduce Heartbeat Thinking, which handles updated input through new Thinker invocations while allowing ongoing invocations and dispatched tools to finish. Periodic invocations read the latest partial transcript and a shared record of completed reasoning and tool results. These results help resolve missing arguments and initiate dependent calls, allowing preparation to progress across speech updates. Across SpeechFCEval, FDBench v3, and AudioCRAG, Heartbeat improves aggregate speculative tool coverage or retrieval reuse over a SHANKS-style windowed baseline, with benchmark-dependent effects on final task quality. On FDBench v3, it increases tool coverage by 16 percentage points and reduces mean final-response latency by 36.4\%. The results show that heartbeat thinking paradigm preserving ongoing computation during speech can turn listening time into reusable preparation for faster and more capable voice-agent responses.

analysis.key_results: 在SpeechFCEval、FDBench v3和AudioCRAG上，比SHANKS风格窗口基线提高了聚合推测工具覆盖率或检索重用；在FDBench v3上工具覆盖率提高16个百分点，平均最终响应延迟降低36.4%。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入心跳思维机制，在语音理解过程中周期性地对最新部分转录进行推理，同时允许已进行中的推理和工具调用完成，实现跨语音更新的推测准备。
analysis.method: 定期调用推理器读取最新部分转录和已完成推理/工具结果的共享记录，以解决缺失参数并发起依赖调用。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出心跳思维方法，利用语音输入过程中持续完成推测推理和工具调用，将等待时间转化为可复用的准备工作。

papers.abstract: Recent efforts have demonstrated the strong capabilities of Multimodal Large Reasoning Models (MLRMs) in geographic reasoning. By jointly analyzing subtle visual cues, these models can infer the locations of photos, thus enabling doxing even by non-expert adversaries. Existing defense methods struggle to balance the shareability of photos with effective protection, and often fail to sufficiently disrupt the implicit geo-evidence chains embedded in scene semantics. To this end, we propose GeoEdit, an adversarial de-evidencing framework for silent geoprivacy protection via image editing. Specifically, we apply minimal edits to high-risk evidence anchors in the image, thereby disrupting the underlying spatial reasoning chains while preserving overall scene semantics. We identify these anchors by combining structured knowledge with adversarially discovered geographic cues. To further navigate the large editing action space, we adopt a learnable policy to iteratively refine editing decisions, distilling successful trajectories into transferable natural-language insights for consistent and efficient editing. Evaluated on LifePhotoBench, GeoEdit achieves strong protection against 6 mainstream MLRMs, outperforming visual perturbation baselines by over 0.59 in image fidelity.

analysis.key_results: 在LifePhotoBench上，GeoEdit对6种主流MLRM实现了强大保护，在图像保真度上比视觉扰动基线高出0.59以上。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出GeoEdit，一个对抗性去证据框架，通过图像编辑实现静默地理隐私保护，在保持图像可分享性的同时有效破坏MLRM的地理推理。
analysis.method: 结合结构化知识与对抗发现的地理线索识别高风险证据锚点，采用可学习策略迭代优化编辑决策，并将成功轨迹蒸馏为可迁移的自然语言见解。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种对抗性图像编辑框架GeoEdit，通过最小编辑高风险证据锚点来破坏多模态大推理模型的地理推理链，从而保护隐私。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作针对多模态大推理模型的地理推理能力进行对抗性干扰，涉及视觉语言模型的空间推理，但不涉及机器人动作预测或世界模型训练；其对抗性编辑策略可潜在启发对VLA/WAM中视觉证据链的鲁棒性评估与攻击，但无直接结合。

papers.abstract: Adversarial vulnerability persists across modern vision architectures from CNNs to vision language models (VLMs), yet existing detection methods rely on heuristics without theoretical guarantees. We address the fundamental question of when adversarial perturbations can be provably detected from a geometric perspective. Our key insight is that adversarial perturbations cannot simultaneously preserve geometric structure across spaces with fundamentally different properties. Accordingly, we construct two such complementary metric spaces. First, we use a standard CNN embedding space $Z$, where adversarial samples exhibit significant displacement patterns. Second, we build a novel prime-quantized space $P$, that absorbs small perturbations through number-theoretic discretization, resulting in minimal displacement, while preserving discriminability. We then leverage the geometric discrepancies across spaces $Z$ and $P$ to detect adversarial samples. To the best of our knowledge, we establish the first rigorous separation theory for adversarial detection, proving that adversarial samples create unavoidable geometric inconsistencies across both spaces. Our framework provides theoretical guarantees including pixel-level absorption bounds, neighborhood diameter concentration, Gromov-Wasserstein (GW) separation theorems, and practical risk control. Extensive experiments validate our theoretical predictions and achieve consistently strong detection performance across a wide range of attack types and model families.

analysis.key_results: 在多种攻击类型和模型家族上取得了稳定且强大的检测性能，验证了理论预测。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出结合素数量化空间和Gromov-Wasserstein度量的对抗样本检测方法，并建立了首个对抗检测的严格分离理论。
analysis.method: 构建两个互补的度量空间：CNN嵌入空间Z和素数量化空间P，利用对抗样本在这两个空间中的几何不一致性进行检测，并给出像素级吸收界、邻域直径集中性、Gromov-Wasserstein分离定理等理论保证。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种基于素数量化空间与CNN嵌入空间几何差异的可证明对抗样本检测框架。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该文聚焦于通用对抗样本检测的量化方法，未直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人策略；但与量化技术相关，对高效推理和模型压缩有一定参考价值。

papers.abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) deliver high-fidelity image and video generation, but inference requires many sequential model evaluations. Two acceleration strategies are increasingly important: model compression makes each evaluation cheaper, while adaptive inference avoids selected teacher computation through reuse, forecasting, or speculative execution. Their combination, however, is brittle: directly applying the evaluated adaptive methods to a compressed student can degrade quality, an observed failure mode we call the \textbf{Combination Gap}. We link this gap to a mismatch between pointwise distillation and short-horizon execution: a student trained at teacher states need not remain reliable when its own predictions are chained. We propose \textbf{TamedFlow}, which trains a compressed DiT for this deployed role through cross-architecture feature alignment, a near-identity Velocity Alignment Head, and randomized rollout supervision. At inference, a lightweight Learnable Trajectory Estimator routes completed drafts: accepted drafts bypass the teacher, while rejected drafts roll back and receive one teacher rescue step. Distilling DiT-XL/2 into DiT-B/2, TamedFlow reaches FID $2.58$ at $2.25\times$ measured speedup over DDIM-50 on ImageNet $256\times256$. Ablations support trajectory supervision, and routing controls favor LTE over random decisions at nearly matched latency. Evaluations on ImageNet $512\times512$, MS-COCO, and Latte/FaceForensics extend the empirical scope.

analysis.key_results: 在 ImageNet 256×256 上，将 DiT-XL/2 蒸馏到 DiT-B/2，TamedFlow 达到 FID 2.58，相对 DDIM-50 实现 2.25 倍实测加速。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 TamedFlow，通过跨架构特征对齐、近恒等速度对齐头和随机 rollout 监督训练压缩 DiT，结合可学习轨迹估计器路由草稿，实现高质量加速采样。
analysis.method: TamedFlow 采用跨架构特征对齐、近恒等速度对齐头、随机 rollout 监督，以及推理时的可学习轨迹估计器路由：接受草稿绕过教师，拒绝草稿回滚并进行一次教师救援步。

papers.abstract: Hosted LLM services increasingly expose model identity as a product claim, but external users and auditors often cannot inspect which model configuration served a request. We study an auditor-assisted regime in which a trusted auditor enrolls claimed identities and prepares verification material before deployment, while audit-time verification uses only the claimed identity and released output, without runtime access to model internals, inference logs, routing decisions, or provider metadata. We propose SUMMARK, a summary-channel watermarking framework that uses user-visible reasoning summaries as a keyed audit surface. During setup, SUMMARK constructs identity-specific vocabulary carriers, trains lightweight summary adapters, and calibrates per-identity thresholds. At deployment time, a keyed statistical test assesses whether the released summary is consistent with the claimed identity and, when needed, attributes the most likely enrolled identity. Across model families, scales, and task domains, SUMMARK reliably detects cross-family and cross-scale substitutions at low false-positive rates while preserving task-facing answer quality. We further study FP16->INT8/INT4 precision-consistency diagnostics and robustness under bounded post-processing, rewriting stress tests, and text-only spoofing, revealing both strong performance and clear failure boundaries. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/trinitr0toluene/Summark.

analysis.key_results: 跨模型族与规模可靠检测替换，低误报率且保持答案质量；FP16->INT8/INT4 精度一致性诊断有效，但在后处理、重写和文本欺骗下存在失败边界。
analysis.limitations: 摘要提到在有限后处理、重写压力测试和纯文本欺骗下存在清晰的失败边界。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 SUMMARK，一种审计辅助的摘要信道水印框架，可在无运行时内部访问的情况下检测和归因托管 LLM 的身份替换。
analysis.method: 通过构建身份特定词汇载体、训练轻量摘要适配器并校准每身份阈值，使用键控统计检验验证摘要与声称身份的一致性。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出 SUMMARK 框架，利用用户可见的推理摘要作为密钥审计表面，以验证托管 LLM 的声称身份并检测模型替换。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文聚焦于托管 LLM 的身份验证，涉及量化精度一致性诊断，与 VLA 或 WAM 无直接关系；但所提出的身份验证方法及量化鲁棒性评估可能为高效模型部署提供参考。

papers.abstract: Integrating force awareness into Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models involves not merely encoding wrench measurements as an additional modality, but determining when and how strongly physical interaction should influence robot action generation. Existing VLAs that use force typically inject it through a fixed pathway, without explicitly determining when it is relevant to the current action. This calls for an intermediate force relevance mechanism inside the VLA, in which visual-language context estimates the relevance of physical feedback to the current task before force enters the action pathway. FR-VLA addresses this gap with a Vision-Language Force-Reasoning Model that uses learnable force query tokens to derive a force admission signal grounded in visual-language context, and uses this signal to modulate an external tokenized force pathway for action generation. In real-world experiments on five contact-rich tasks across two robotic platforms, FR-VLA achieves the highest mean success rate over six evaluated stages, and trajectory visualizations show that its force admission varies with the interaction phase.

analysis.key_results: 在五类接触丰富任务和两个机器人平台上的真实世界实验中，FR-VLA在六个评估阶段中取得了最高的平均成功率；轨迹可视化显示其力准入信号随交互阶段变化。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出FR-VLA，其核心贡献是视觉-语言力推理模型：利用可学习的力查询token生成基于视觉-语言上下文的力准入信号，并以此调制外部token化的力通路，从而决定力反馈何时及多强地影响动作生成。
analysis.method: 使用视觉-语言力推理模型，通过可学习的力查询token生成力准入信号，并用该信号调制外部token化的力通路进行动作生成。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出FR-VLA，一种通过视觉-语言上下文自适应调节力反馈影响的视觉-语言-动作模型，用于接触丰富操作任务。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接聚焦于VLA模型，引入力反馈的自适应推理机制，属于机器人操作和策略学习范畴，对VLA与物理交互的融合具有直接研究价值。

papers.abstract: Fast and reliable manipulation is crucial for practical robot deployment. Although Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently shown remarkable progress as generalist robot policies, their execution often remains temporally inefficient. A key source of this inefficiency is that policies learn fine-grained temporal patterns from teleoperated demonstrations, requiring many low-level action steps. Temporal action quantization offers a simple way to accelerate execution by aggregating consecutive low-level actions into temporally coarser actions. However, applying action quantization without considering when fine-grained control is required introduces a speed-accuracy trade-off: accelerated actions may efficiently reduce redundant steps in some phases, while discarding critical motion details in precision-sensitive interactions. To address this, we propose PaceVLA, a unified framework for adaptive temporal execution in VLAs that integrates two coupled components: (1) mode-specific action decoders built on a shared action expert, supporting multiple temporal granularities and prediction horizons, and (2) a quantizability-guided mode selection scheme which decides whether coarse execution is appropriate, and a context-conditioned router that selects an execution mode at each inference step. Experiments across three multi-task simulation benchmarks and six real-world tasks show that PaceVLA improves execution efficiency while maintaining task success rate across multiple embodiments, including long-horizon and dexterous manipulation.

analysis.key_results: 在三个多任务仿真基准和六个真实世界任务中，PaceVLA在多种机器人形态下提高了执行效率，同时保持了任务成功率，包括长时序和灵巧操作任务。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出PaceVLA，一个统一的VLA自适应时序执行框架，集成多模式动作解码器和可量化性引导的模式选择与路由机制。
analysis.method: PaceVLA由共享动作专家构建的多粒度动作解码器和基于可量化性评估与上下文路由的模式选择方案组成。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出PaceVLA框架，通过自适应时序动作量化在VLA策略中动态选择合适的动作粒度，以提升执行效率并保持任务成功率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接关注VLA模型的高效推理与执行，通过时序动作量化减少冗余低层动作步数，属于VLA/WAM相关，但未涉及世界模型。

papers.abstract: Robot manipulation often depends on short-term cues - such as brief contacts, temporary occlusions, and intermediate object states - that are ambiguous in a single frame and can only be resolved by integrating observations over time. However, injecting historical information solely by enlarging the history window is computationally costly and frequently yields limited gains due to substantial redundancy and task-agnostic, inflexible sampling of observations. We propose CondenseVLA, a multi-frame VLA policy with a learnable decoder-side history condensation module for using short-term visual context in action decoding. Given a sequence of cached per-frame features from the VLM backbone, CondenseVLA distills observation history into a fixed set of slot tokens using learnable queries and multi-head cross-attention. Simple auxiliary regularization penalizes overlap among slot attention maps and decorrelates slot embeddings, encouraging complementary attention and reducing slot redundancy. Across the evaluated tasks, CondenseVLA improves Simpler-WidowX success from 58.7% to 69.8% (+11.1 percentage points), achieves 97.2% on LIBERO, and reaches 52.8% on real-world tasks. It achieves 21.6% success on memory-dependent RMBench tasks. These results support selective condensation of bounded recent visual evidence for action decoding, while harder multi-observation tasks expose the limits of a finite history window. Project page: https://github.com/FeiyangHong/CondenseVLA

analysis.key_results: 在Simpler-WidowX上成功率从58.7%提升到69.8%（增加11.1个百分点）；LIBERO达到97.2%；真实世界任务达到52.8%；在记忆相关RMBench任务上达到21.6%。
analysis.limitations: 在更困难的多观察任务中，有限历史窗口暴露出性能局限。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出CondenseVLA，一种带可学习历史压缩模块的多帧VLA策略，能在动作解码中有效利用短期视觉上下文且避免扩大历史窗口的高计算成本。
analysis.method: 利用可学习查询和多头交叉注意力，将缓存的逐帧VLM特征压缩为固定数量的槽token，并通过辅助正则化惩罚槽注意力图重叠和去相关槽嵌入，促进互补注意力。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: CondenseVLA通过可学习的解码端历史压缩模块，将多帧观察特征提炼为固定槽token，提升VLA策略的动作解码效率与性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文直接面向视觉-语言-动作(VLA)策略的高效推理，提出历史压缩模块来增强多帧VLA的动作解码，与本站关注的高效VLA推理和策略学习方法高度相关。

papers.abstract: Large-language-model register-transfer-level (RTL) generation has concentrated on how to train the model: fine-tuning, continued pre-training, and reinforcement learning from a verifier. We argue this is the second-order question. On a bounded, formally specifiable task of generating single-error-correcting, double-error-detecting (SECDED) ECC memory wrappers, we hold the task, data, and correctness oracle fixed and vary two axes independently: the training regime (seven settings) and the output representation (four levels, from fully expanded flat Verilog to an eight-field configuration expanded by a deterministic generator). Because a reference generator exists, correctness is decided by formal equivalence over a design space of approximately ten million points, rather than sampled from a hand-written testbench. Two results follow. First, representation dominates: every representation close to raw RTL reaches a pass rate of at most 0.17, while the configuration reaches 0.83 with no training at all. Once the model emits the configuration, every training regime achieves a pass rate between 0.89 and 1.00. Second, raw RTL hits a hard output-length limit: a 512-bit design requires 44,237 tokens of flat Verilog compared with just 69 tokens for the configuration. Consequently, raw generation becomes infeasible above 32-bit data words rather than merely inaccurate. A model trained from scratch with fewer than 50 million parameters, combined with the verified generator, achieves 0.89 formal equivalence, compared with 1.00 for a 32-billion-parameter fine-tuned model, while using approximately 1600 times less inference energy per correct design. Inference energy also dominates amortized training energy. The lesson is to learn the interface, not the implementation.

analysis.key_results: 配置级表示无需训练即可达到0.83通过率，所有训练策略在配置表示下通过率为0.89-1.00；原始RTL表示最佳通过率仅0.17；512位设计需要44237个token的扁平Verilog，而配置表示仅需69 token；小于5000万参数的模型配合生成器达到0.89形式等价，32B微调模型为1.00，但前者每次正确设计的推理能耗低约1600倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 在固定任务、数据和正确性判定器的条件下，证明输出表示比训练策略更关键：配置级表示无需训练即可达到0.83通过率，而任何接近原始RTL的表示通过率最高仅0.17；同时配置表示将512位设计的输出长度从44237 token降至69 token，大幅降低推理能耗。
analysis.method: 在单纠错双检错(SECDED)ECC内存包装器生成任务上，固定任务与数据，独立改变训练策略（七种）和输出表示（四种，从扁平Verilog到八字段配置），使用形式等价验证和后端生成器评估生成正确性和效率。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 论文在硬件RTL生成任务中发现输出表示对生成正确性和推理能耗的影响超过训练策略，低维配置表示结合小模型即可高效实现正确设计。

papers.abstract: Robotic manipulation is not merely observation-to-action generation, but the realization of task-specified state changes in the physical world. Existing vision-language-action (VLA) methods directly learn observation-to-action mappings, imposing a substantial learning burden due to the gap between semantic understanding and action execution. Although world-action models (WAMs) improve control through future prediction, modeling complete future states wastes capacity on static appearance and action-irrelevant changes. We propose Vision-Language-Delta-Action (VLDA), a paradigm that reformulates full future prediction as compact actionable transition modeling. Its core is a compact Delta variable that captures latent world-state changes, serving as an interface between vision-language understanding and action generation. VLDA learns Delta through a unified objective composed of the Local Transition Filter (LT-Filter) and Global Transition Anchor (GT-Anchor). LT-Filter captures task-relevant manipulation-centric changes while suppressing static reconstruction biases. GT-Anchor provides coarse future-level regularization to preserve the overall direction of state changes. Delta-Driven Action Refinement (DDAR) further grounds Delta in the action manifold and injects it as a structured seed to guide action denoising. We implement VLDA within LoongForge, an open-source training framework for large-scale foundation and embodied models, using its modular and distributed infrastructure for unified two-stage optimization. Experiments show that VLDA improves long-horizon consistency, robustness, and generalization, validating actionable Delta as an alternative to direct action prediction and full future-state modeling.

analysis.key_results: 实验表明VLDA在长时程一致性、鲁棒性和泛化性方面有所提升，验证了可执行Delta作为直接动作预测和完整未来状态建模的替代方案的有效性。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了Vision-Language-Delta-Action (VLDA)范式，将完整的未来预测重构为紧凑的可执行转移建模，核心是捕获潜在世界状态变化的Delta变量，作为视觉语言理解与动作生成之间的接口。
analysis.method: 通过统一目标学习Delta，该目标由局部转移过滤器(LT-Filter)和全局转移锚点(GT-Anchor)组成；LT-Filter捕获任务相关的操作中心变化并抑制静态重构偏差，GT-Anchor提供粗粒度的未来级正则化以保持状态变化的整体方向；Delta驱动动作细化(DDAR)将Delta锚定在动作流形中，并将其作为结构化种子注入以指导动作去噪。在LoongForge开源框架中实现统一两阶段优化。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出VLDA范式，通过紧凑Delta变量建模可执行的状态转移，作为视觉语言理解与动作生成之间的接口，以改进机器人操作。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接针对VLA和WAM的不足，提出一种新的范式，将世界建模从完整状态预测转换为紧凑的可执行转移Delta，作为视觉语言理解与动作生成之间的接口，旨在降低学习负担并提高机器人操作性能。

papers.abstract: Time-series models increasingly condition on known future inputs. In controlled systems, some of these inputs are actions that can be changed, compared, and optimized before execution. A model must therefore do more than predict the realized future: it must predict how outcomes change under different actions from the same observed history and support reliable comparison of candidate plans. We introduce ActTime, an action-conditioned world model for time series. Over the observed history, ActTime updates variable-specific latent states through an action-conditioned transition and corrects them using observations. It then rolls the same transition forward under candidate actions to generate future trajectories. Training uses only factual trajectories, without paired alternative-action outcomes or planning supervision. We construct a simulator-grounded evaluation suite across building energy, traffic, greenhouse climate, and inventory management, covering factual prediction, intervention-effect prediction, offline decision making, and closed-loop planning. ActTime ranks first in 12 of 16 domain-task settings. Across eight methods, the mean pairwise model-ranking reversal rate is 17.8% between factual prediction and intervention fidelity, and rises to 28.4% between intervention fidelity and decision ranking. These results show that factual accuracy, intervention fidelity, and decision quality are related but not interchangeable.

analysis.key_results: ActTime 在16个领域任务设置中12项排名第一；事实预测与干预保真度之间的平均成对模型排名反转率为17.8%，干预保真度与决策排名之间为28.4%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 ActTime，一种基于动作条件转换与观测校正的动作条件世界模型，能够从纯事实轨迹中学习干预效果与候选计划比较。
analysis.method: 在观测历史上进行动作条件的状态转移与观测校正，然后在候选动作下前向滚动同一转移生成未来轨迹。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: ActTime 提出一种动作条件的时间序列世界模型，通过历史状态更新与候选动作前向滚动来预测干预效果并支持决策规划。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作聚焦于通用时间序列的动作条件世界模型，并未直接涉及 VLA、机器人动作预测或机器人世界模型，但其动作条件转换与规划评估方法对机器人动作世界建模具有潜在的方法学参考价值。

papers.abstract: Dynamic object manipulation requires robots to anticipate target motion while replanning fast enough to avoid executing outdated actions. Existing approaches either rely on fast reactive control without an explicit future target state or encode anticipated motion only implicitly. World Action Models (WAMs) offer a promising alternative by coupling future visual prediction with action generation, but scene-level video objectives may underrepresent target dynamics that are critical for manipulation, while iterative video-action denoising introduces substantial latency. We present TrajWAM, a trajectory-guided world action model for efficient dynamic robotic manipulation. Our key insight is to explicitly ground future visual imagination in predicted target-object motion and use the resulting future representation to condition action generation, while preserving this anticipation pathway after acceleration. Given a short history of object masks, a history-conditioned motion predictor forecasts future masks encoding the target object's trajectory. A lightweight Trajectory ControlNet then steers a pretrained video model toward trajectory-consistent futures. The resulting future representation conditions an action expert to predict executable action chunks. To enable one-step inference without breaking this interface, we introduce a decoupled distillation scheme that combines distribution matching for the video backbone, Trajectory ControlNet realignment, and action rollout distillation to support accurate one-step action prediction conditioned on the compressed future representation. Comprehensive evaluations in simulation and the real world show that TrajWAM achieves state-of-the-art performance on dynamic object manipulation tasks while enabling efficient one-step video-action inference. Project page: https://kevingeng3.github.io/TrajWAM/.

analysis.key_results: 在仿真和真实世界的动态物体操作任务中取得了最优性能，并实现了高效的一步视频-动作推断。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了 TrajWAM，一种轨迹引导的世界行动模型，通过将目标物体的未来运动显式地融入未来视觉预测与动作生成，并设计解耦蒸馏方案支持高效的一步推断。
analysis.method: 使用历史物体掩码预测未来掩码，通过轻量级 Trajectory ControlNet 引导预训练视频模型生成轨迹一致的未来表示，并用该表示条件化动作专家预测动作块；此外，通过分布匹配、ControlNet 重对齐和动作展开蒸馏实现一步推断。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: TrajWAM 提出一种轨迹引导的世界行动模型，通过预测目标物体未来运动来条件化视觉预测与动作生成，并采用解耦蒸馏实现高效的一步推断。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作与 WAM 主题高度相关，直接改进了世界行动模型在动态操作中的目标运动建模与推断效率，为 VLA/WAM 在机器人操作中的应用提供了新方法。

(a) Existing WAMs may fail to accurately anticipate target-object motion, resulting in future predictions that deviate from the actual trajectory. TrajWAM uses predicted future object masks as trajectory guidance to generate motion-consistent futures for action prediction. (b) Success rate and inference latency on DOMINO. TrajWAM achieves state-of-the-art performance while maintaining efficient inference.

figures.caption: Overview of TrajWAM. (a) Training pipeline. A language-conditioned segmentation model extracts the mask history of the target object, from which a motion predictor forecasts a sequence of future masks representing its anticipated trajectory. The predicted mask trajectory guides future-video generation through a Trajectory ControlNet, and the resulting trajectory-controlled video representation conditions the action branch through asymmetric video–action attention to predict an executable action chunk. (b) Inference pipeline. Target-object masks are updated online from incoming observations and maintained in a short history buffer. papers.abstract: Autonomous driving fundamentally demands dense understanding of visual, semantic, and geometric information, yet existing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are typically trained with sparse supervision such as language instructions or trajectory signals. This direct mapping from dense visual observations to sparse representations forces the model to compress or even discard critical scene information essential for safe driving. We argue that this limitation does not stem from insufficient model capacity, but from the lack of explicit mechanisms that encourage the formation of dense world representations in the latent space. In this spirit, we propose a novel paradigm for driving intelligence, Think Densely, Act Sparsely, and instantiate it with an efficient and interpretable framework, LECDrive (Latent Expert Cognitive Chains for Vision-Language-Action autonomous Driving). The core idea is to mimic the hierarchical perception process of humans by embedding a progressive chain of latent expert cognition within the VLA model. Concretely, we inject a compact set of task-specific latent tokens as carriers, enabling the model to internalize dense knowledge from foundational vision models, including visual representations (DINOv3), semantic structures (SAM3), and spatial geometry (DepthAnything3), while maintaining efficient inference. This interdependent cognitive chain follows a curriculum learning principle, where supervision is progressively structured from representation to semantics and geometry. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LECDrive consistently improves the performance of base VLMs across multiple autonomous driving benchmarks, covering key tasks such as object perception, state prediction, and trajectory planning. These findings suggest that constructing dense world models through structured latent expert chains is a promising direction for VLA-based autonomous driving.

analysis.key_results: LECDrive在多个自动驾驶基准上一致提升了基础VLM的性能，覆盖目标感知、状态预测和轨迹规划等关键任务。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种新的自动驾驶智能范式“稠密思考，稀疏行动”，并实例化为名为LECDrive的框架，该框架在VLA模型中嵌入渐进的潜在专家认知链，以从基础视觉模型中内化稠密知识，同时保持高效推理。
analysis.method: 在VLA模型内部注入一组紧凑的任务特定潜在令牌作为载体，利用DINOv3、SAM3和DepthAnything3等基础视觉模型，按照课程学习原则从表征到语义再到几何逐步内化稠密知识。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出LECDrive框架，通过注入潜在专家认知链来构建稠密世界表征，从而提升视觉-语言-动作自动驾驶模型的性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在自动驾驶中的应用，核心贡献是构建稠密世界表征（可视为一种内部世界建模），并通过潜在专家链实现高效推理，与本站主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Humanoid robots operating in human-centric environments must coordinate the entire body to traverse tight, cluttered spaces while maintaining balance. Existing methods often struggle to jointly consider dynamic stability and collision avoidance from high-dimensional perceptual inputs. Moreover, for humanoids, safe behavior is inherently multimodal: the same obstacle may admit multiple valid traversals, which is difficult to represent with a single deterministic policy. To address these challenges, we propose SWAP (Steerable Whole-body Avoidance Policy), a hierarchical framework that separates collision-aware decision making from stabilization. A high-level, perception-conditioned diffusion policy generates multimodal, collision-aware motion proposals, while a low-level whole-body RL controller tracks these proposals and maintains dynamic balance. To efficiently train the high-level policy, we obtain scalable supervision via hindsight labeling: we roll out the low-level policy under randomized commands, place obstacles only in the space that each executed motion did not sweep, so the motion is collision-free by construction, and re-render the perception the robot would have seen. At deployment, Monte Carlo sampling with simple cost signals steers the diffusion model toward safe, task-aligned behaviors without heavy reward tuning. Experiments in simulation and on a real Unitree G1 humanoid show reliable avoidance with static and dynamic obstacles. Test-time steering further enables customization, improving targeted rewards (e.g., speed, orientation, or posture) by 34% on average while maintaining a high collision avoidance rate. Together, these results support a practical solution to humanoid whole-body collision avoidance with test-time steerability. Project website: https://iscoyizj.github.io/SWAP-steerable-humanoid-oa-website/

analysis.key_results: 在仿真和真实Unitree G1人形机器人上实现静态和动态障碍物的可靠避让；测试时转向平均提升目标奖励（速度、朝向或姿态）34%，同时保持高避碰率。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出SWAP框架，将碰撞感知决策与稳定控制分离，用感知条件的扩散策略生成多模态全身避碰运动，并利用事后标记获得可扩展监督，支持测试时转向自定义行为。
analysis.method: 分层框架：高层感知条件扩散策略生成碰撞感知运动提案，低层全身RL控制器跟踪并保持平衡；通过事后标记（回放低层策略、只在未被扫过的空间放置障碍物、重新渲染感知）训练高层策略；部署时用蒙特卡洛采样和简单成本信号引导扩散模型。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: SWAP采用分层框架，高层扩散策略生成多模态避碰运动提案，低层RL控制器跟踪并维持平衡，实现人形机器人在杂乱环境中的全身碰撞避让与测试时转向。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作面向人形机器人全身动作生成，结合感知条件扩散策略与强化学习，属于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略学习范畴，与本站主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Continuous vision-and-language navigation (VLN) is typically evaluated by goal-reaching success, assuming it reflects an agent's ability to execute language-grounded behavior. We show that this assumption can fail: permissive contact models in current simulators may mask physically infeasible actions, creating a physical executability gap between semantic competence and embodied realization. To bridge this gap, we introduce Visual-Semantic Traversability Alignment (VeSTA), a framework that aligns VLN policies with physically executable futures. We define visual-semantic traversability as the ability to predict instruction-conditioned trajectories that are semantically valid, geometrically feasible, and physically robust. VeSTA addresses this misalignment through two complementary mechanisms: improving executable support in trajectory generation and risk-aware selection among multimodal futures. Specifically, Trajectory Relative Group Policy Optimization uses strict-contact feedback to reshape the candidate distribution toward executable regions, while the Traversability Risk Critic learns a risk-adjusted scalar utility for candidate-wise future selection. Experiments on R2R and RxR reveal substantial dependence of existing VLN agents on simulator contact semantics. Under strict-contact evaluation, VeSTA substantially reduces collision-induced failures while preserving or improving goal-reaching performance, and controlled real-world robot experiments provide evidence that the learned preference transfers beyond simulation.

analysis.key_results: 在严格接触评估下，VeSTA显著减少碰撞导致的失败，同时保持或提高目标达成性能；仿真外的真实机器人实验表明学习偏好可迁移
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Visual-Semantic Traversability Alignment (VeSTA)框架，通过Trajectory Relative Group Policy Optimization和Traversability Risk Critic两个机制，提高VLN策略的物理可执行性
analysis.method: 定义视觉语义可遍历性，利用严格接触反馈重塑候选分布，并学习风险调整的标量效用进行候选未来选择
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 针对视觉语言导航中评估指标与实际物理可执行性脱节的问题，提出VeSTA框架来对齐策略与物理可行的未来。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接关注视觉语言导航（VLN）中的物理可执行性问题，属于VLA范畴，但未涉及世界模型或机械臂操作；其方法改进了具身智能体在仿真和现实中的行动选择，与机器人学习密切相关
