papers.abstract: Recent advances in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models and World Action Models (WAMs) have expanded the manipulation and whole body capabilities of individual robots. Yet a single robot remains limited by its embodiment, and many real world tasks require capabilities that can only emerge through cooperation. Existing multi robot frameworks largely emphasize task decomposition, allocation, and replanning, while providing limited support for adapting executable coordination when physical execution deviates from the intended behavior. We present CoEvolve, a framework that represents team coordination as executable code over fixed robot motor skills. CoEvolve introduces Verifier Guided Coordination Evolution, where a multimodal foundation model instantiates coordination strategies through motion primitives, semantic objectives, temporary robot roles, and bounded execution parameters. Physical verification evaluates each executed transition, rejected behaviors trigger structured coordination revision from an accepted checkpoint, and verified experience is retained to guide subsequent decisions. We evaluate CoEvolve with two simulated Unitree G1 humanoids transporting a freely supported rigid payload through constrained corridors. Across 15 base task runs with three multimodal backbone families, CoEvolve completes 8 tasks, with every backbone achieving end to end success. Additional evaluations yield verified placement on two additional corridor layouts and after both same-backbone and cross-backbone experience initialization, while exposing persistent limitations in motion precision and contact stability. These results support executable coordination as a practical interface for adapting long horizon multi robot collaboration under shared physical constraints.

analysis.key_results: 在15个基础任务中完成8个，所有三种多模态骨干均实现端到端成功；在两种新走廊布局上验证了放置，并展示了同骨干和跨骨干经验初始化的有效性。
analysis.limitations: 运动精度和接触稳定性方面存在持续局限。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种将团队协调表示为可执行代码的框架，并引入验证引导的协调进化机制，使多机器人系统能够在物理约束下自进化协调策略。
analysis.method: Verifier Guided Coordination Evolution，通过多模态基础模型实例化运动原语、语义目标、临时角色和有界执行参数，结合物理验证与结构化修订。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: CoEvolve通过可执行代码协调多机器人团队，并利用验证引导的进化框架适应物理执行偏差。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文直接利用VLA模型的能力来生成和演进化人形机器人的协调代码策略，将VLA与多机器人协作执行相集成，与机器人动作生成和策略学习高度相关。

papers.abstract: Vision--Language--Action (VLA) models promise generalist robotic agents, yet consolidating skills learned across heterogeneous tasks and environments remains difficult: training data is fragmented across platforms, joint multi-task training suffers from interference, and model merging tends to introduce parameter conflicts or require architectural changes. We instead advocate a paradigm in which skills are first learned independently and then consolidated post hoc. To this end, we propose NestedVLA, which replaces parameter aggregation with parameter generation: a nested hypernetwork, conditioned on the target task, synthesizes task-adaptive action-expert parameters that compose with a frozen base VLA. Task-specific compressed VLM residuals are retained separately. This formulation enables flexible task-conditioned skill reuse while mitigating interference. Across three RL benchmarks (MetaWorld, ManiSkill, CALVIN), NestedVLA outperforms the strongest model-merging baseline by 41 pp on average, matches per-task fine-tuning within 1 pp on ManiSkill, and substantially closes the gap on CALVIN, pointing toward a storage-efficient route to skill consolidation. Code is available at https://github.com/WanyuGroup/NeurIPS2026-NestedVLA.

analysis.key_results: 在MetaWorld、ManiSkill、CALVIN上，NestedVLA平均比最强模型合并基线高41个百分点，在ManiSkill上与单任务微调差距在1个百分点以内。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出NestedVLA，用嵌套超网络替代参数聚合，实现任务条件化的技能整合，在三个RL基准上显著优于模型合并基线。
analysis.method: 嵌套超网络，以目标任务为条件，合成任务自适应动作专家参数，与冻结基础VLA组合；任务特定压缩VLM残差被分离保留。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: NestedVLA通过嵌套超网络为冻结的基础VLA生成任务自适应动作专家参数，以事后整合异构任务技能，避免联合训练干扰。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作以VLA模型为核心，解决机器人技能整合问题，属于VLA策略学习，与本主题高度相关。

(b) NestedVLA retains a compressed task-specific VLM update and uses an embedded task-conditioned hypernetwork to generate the action-expert update. Both updates are applied to a shared base to materialize the selected VLA.

figures.caption: NestedVLA pipeline. (1) Skill acquisition : each task is fine-tuned independently from the same base Θ 0 \Theta_{0} and the resulting task vector τ m \tau_{m} is compressed into a sparse skill z m = α ⋅ τ m ⊙ M m z_{m}=\alpha\cdot\tau_{m}\odot M_{m} via drop-and-rescale. (2) Skill consolidation : a single nested hypernetwork 𝒢 ϕ \mathcal{G}_{\phi} is trained against the action-expert portions of { z m } \{z_{m}\} with a multi-task masked MSE loss. (3) Skill generation : at inference, querying 𝒢 ϕ \mathcal{G}_{\phi} with task id m m generates the action-expert update; the corresponding compressed VLM update is retrieved and both compose with the frozen base.

papers.abstract: Real-time interaction requires agents to perceive evolving environments and act under temporal constraints, yet existing evaluations of real-time streaming models focus on conversational quality and streaming perception, leaving effective action under strict temporal constraints untested. We introduce Realtime-Bench, a suite of carefully curated dynamic tasks where delayed actions directly affect success. Under Wall Clock, where environments advance according to actual inference latency, the best success rate reaches only 44% and the best Pass^3 is only 36%, demonstrating that real-time interaction remains challenging. To separate serving latency from models' real-time streaming capability, we compare Wall Clock with Paused Clock, which removes inference delays as an idealized reference, and introduce Token Clock, which advances simulated time according to generated token counts, testing temporal awareness independently of physical serving speed. We find that temporal costs limit success in evolving environments and that higher reasoning effort has mixed effects under time pressure, reflecting a trade-off between decision quality and timely execution. These findings suggest directions for improving real-time multimodal agents, including adaptive reasoning with temporal awareness and continuous perception and action.

analysis.key_results: 在Wall Clock下最佳成功率为44%，最佳Pass^3为36%；时间成本限制成功率，更高的推理努力在时间压力下效果混合。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Realtime-Bench基准，通过Wall Clock、Paused Clock和Token Clock三种时钟协议，系统评估模型在实时交互中延迟对任务成功的影响。
analysis.method: 构建动态任务套件，对比Wall Clock（真实推理延迟）、Paused Clock（理想无延迟）和Token Clock（按生成token推进模拟时间）下的智能体表现。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 引入Realtime-Bench，一个评估实时多模态智能体在动态环境中及时行动能力的基准测试。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作聚焦于实时交互中的推理延迟与时间约束，对VLA/WAM系统在真实机器人场景中的实时决策效率具有间接参考价值，但并非直接针对VLA或WAM。

papers.abstract: We study how vision-language models (VLMs) can learn to think and actively explore in 3D space. Instead of providing multi-view images, videos, or 3D representations to the model, we preserve the native visual encoding of VLMs, i.e., a single image, one at a time, just like humans, and treat the 3D representation only as an environment with which the model can interact through actions (e.g., move left) and observations (rendered images). Each rollout begins from an initial first-person view and a visual question. The model can then iteratively reason, navigate, and reorient its viewpoint before committing to a final answer. Following an initial trajectory-supervised finetuning, we apply reinforcement learning (RL) with rewards driven primarily by final-answer correctness. Crucially, RL provides no direct supervision over which viewpoints the model should visit or which exploration actions it should take. Instead, the model must learn an effective exploration policy solely from the extent to which its interactions improve performance. Across six 3D benchmarks, our model ACT3D achieves an average accuracy of 53.2% that improves its base Qwen model by 22.0% and surpasses proprietary Gemini 3.6 Flash. ACT3D also outperforms existing open-source 3D methods while using 50-70% fewer input frames, and generalizes to unseen domains with an average improvement of 5.9% over its supervised initialization. Further analysis reveals adaptive, question-conditioned exploration. Performance gains over the base model increase from 0.6% on questions answerable from the initial view to 16.3% on those requiring extensive exploration. ACT3D searches for occluded targets, avoids unnecessary exploration, and acquires complementary viewpoints for spatial comparisons. These findings demonstrate that outcome-based RL enables VLMs not only to reason over visual evidence, but also to learn when and how to acquire it.

analysis.key_results: 在六个3D基准上平均准确率53.2%，比基础Qwen模型提升22.0%，超越Gemini 3.6 Flash，相比现有开源3D方法使用少50-70%的输入帧，并在未见领域平均提升5.9%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出ACT3D模型，通过强化学习使视觉语言模型学会主动探索3D环境，无需多视图或3D表示，并基于最终答案正确性塑造探索策略。
analysis.method: 初始轨迹监督微调后使用强化学习，奖励主要由最终答案正确性驱动，模型通过迭代推理、导航和视点重定向来交互式探索。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 通过仅使用单张图像输入，让视觉语言模型在与3D环境交互中学习思考和主动探索，从而提升视觉问答的准确性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文研究视觉语言模型在3D环境中的主动探索和策略学习，对世界模型和机器人学习中关于环境交互与信息获取的策略有价值，但与机器人动作预测或世界动作模型无直接关联。

papers.abstract: Robotic manipulation is inherently geometric, but what shape does the world take inside the policy that performs it? Prior work on vision-language-action (VLA) policies establishes that task-relevant variables are linearly readable from activations, yet readability certifies only that a variable is present and says nothing about the shape its values trace, which may be curved and multi-dimensional. Using controlled sweeps, natural rollouts, linear probes, and activation interventions, we build a taxonomy of seven task-relevant concepts in VLA models. We find that realized geometry is predominantly multi-dimensional and is shaped by the constraints under which the policy acts. Physical joint limits, for example, leave wrist orientation an open arc rather than a circle, and distance to the target, a single scalar, is realized in two orthogonal subspaces, a coarse ruler for the approach and a fine ruler for the grasp. The same geometries reappear in two further VLA models on real-world robot data, indicating that they are neither model-specific nor artifacts of simulation. We demonstrate how the findings are actionable by steering along the geometry a concept realizes. Overall, this work lays out an initial phenomenology of realized geometry in VLA policies and demonstrates that a concept's shape carries as much importance as its readability.

analysis.key_results: 实现的几何形状主要是多维的：例如，手腕方向形成一个开放弧线而非圆形，目标距离分别实现在两个正交子空间（接近阶段用粗尺，抓取阶段用细尺）；相同几何形状在基于真实世界机器人数据的两个VLA模型上重现。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了VLA模型中任务相关概念神经几何的初步现象学，表明概念的几何形状与其可读性同样重要。
analysis.method: 使用受控扫描、自然轨迹、线性探针和激活干预来构建七个任务相关概念的几何分类，并在两个额外的VLA模型上验证了发现的几何形状。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文建立了VLA策略中七个任务相关概念的神经几何分类，发现其几何形状是多维的，并受策略执行约束的影响。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 与VLA主题高度相关，直接研究VLA策略内部的神经几何结构，并提供了可操作的发现（沿着概念实现几何方向进行引导）。

papers.abstract: Video generators serve as interactive worlds for exploration and simulation, yet realistic and visually appealing frames do not necessarily depict a consistent 3D world. Existing benchmarks assess selected geometric properties or use vision-language models to judge memory and consistency, leaving systematic 3D evaluation underexplored. We introduce Orbia, the first benchmark dedicated to a systematic and comprehensive evaluation of 3D consistency in interactive world models. Through controlled exploration and revisit, we organize the evaluation into three dimensions: input preservation, generated-content persistence, and 3D self-consistency. For input preservation, registered RGB-D references and annotated anchors support appearance, geometry, and spatial stability measurements. For generated-content persistence, we compare revisits to regions absent from the input image with their first generated observations to test whether models preserve what they create. For 3D self-consistency, cross-view depth and feature correspondence, regional scale agreement, and held-out Gaussian rendering test whether generated views describe the same 3D scene. Minute-long exploration and revisits further test long-term consistency. Our construction and annotation pipeline brings together public datasets, self-captured scenes, and simulation, yielding 720 instances across indoor and outdoor environments and six exploration-and-revisit protocols. Evaluation spans 27 text-, action-, and camera-conditioned models through native-interface adapters. Our Orbia benchmark provides a systematic basis for diagnosing 3D inconsistency and developing more persistent video world models.

analysis.key_results: 构建了涵盖室内外环境及六种探索-回访协议的720个实例，并评估了27个文本、动作和相机条件模型。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了Orbia基准，首个针对交互式世界模型3D一致性进行系统和全面评估的基准。
analysis.method: 通过受控探索与回访，将评估组织为输入保持、生成内容持久性和3D自一致性三个维度，并使用注册RGB-D参考、注释锚点、跨视图深度与特征对应、区域尺度一致性及留出高斯渲染等方法。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: Orbia是首个系统评估交互式世界模型中3D一致性的基准，通过受控探索和回访从输入保持、生成内容持久性和3D自一致性三个维度进行评测。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该基准直接针对世界模型（WAM）的3D一致性评估，对机器人世界建模和具身智能中的环境一致性研究具有重要价值，但未涉及VLA或动作预测。

papers.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by drafting multiple tokens per step, yet feature-based drafters rely on target hidden features whose contextual emphasis may not align with the needs of subsequent draft positions. Hybrid linear attention (HLA) models maintain compact recurrent states that accumulate historical associations, offering an efficient source of complementary context for speculative drafting. We introduce ReaDy, the first speculative decoding method, to the best of our knowledge, to leverage HLA recurrent states for position-specific context retrieval during drafting. ReaDy equips each draft position with a learned query to retrieve supplementary context directly from the target's committed recurrent states. A lightweight state reader integrates this context into draft representations through residual updates, while low-rank state reads and fused operators keep additional computation and I/O overhead low. Building on DSpark's parallel backbone and sequential prediction head, ReaDy employs a lightweight two-stage adaptation strategy, with reader capacity, state sources, and residual placement examined through ablation studies. Across seven benchmarks spanning mathematics, code generation, and dialogue, ReaDy achieves an average $3.16\times$ decoding speedup over autoregressive decoding with Qwen3.8-27B on a single NVIDIA B200 GPU. It outperforms DSpark on every benchmark, improving throughput by 7.97% and acceptance length by 8.50% on average. Our code is available at https://github.com/StartLuxLabs/ReaDy.

analysis.key_results: 在涵盖数学、代码生成和对话的七个基准上，使用 Qwen3.8-27B 在单个 NVIDIA B200 GPU 上相比自回归解码平均实现 3.16 倍加速；在每个基准上均优于 DSpark，平均吞吐量提升 7.97%，接受长度提升 8.50%。
analysis.main_contribution: 首个利用混合线性注意力（HLA）循环状态进行位置特定上下文检索的投机解码方法 ReaDy。
analysis.method: 为每个草稿位置使用学习到的查询从目标模型的已提交循环状态中检索补充上下文，并通过轻量级状态读取器以残差更新方式集成到草稿表示中，同时采用低秩状态读取和融合算子减少计算与 I/O 开销。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: ReaDy 利用混合线性注意力模型的循环状态为投机解码中的每个草稿位置检索上下文，从而提升草稿质量。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文针对投机解码这一独立的高效推理主题，未涉及 VLA、WAM 或机器人学习，因此与本站主题无直接关系，但该方法可潜在应用于任何基于混合线性注意力架构的自回归模型，包括未来可能的具身模型。

papers.abstract: Action-chunking vision-language-action (VLA) models predict sequences of future robot actions. Under fixed-horizon execution, the robot executes a fixedlength prefix of each predicted chunk before invoking the policy again, leaving the remaining predictions unused. For a given number of executed actions, short execution horizons require more policy calls. Extending the execution horizon amortizes policy inference cost over more actions. However, uniformly applying long horizons across episodes can limit opportunities for precise corrections. To address this limitation, we propose PICES (Perturbation-Informed Chunk and Execution Horizon Selection), a training-free method that jointly selects an action chunk and the number of actions executed before the next policy call. Within a single policy call, the action expert generates a batch of action chunks from multiple initial noise samples and their locally perturbed counterparts, using the same conditioning features across all samples. PICES exploits differences between corresponding actions in each nominal chunk and its counterpart to determine candidate-specific execution horizons and select a nominal chunk for execution. Experiments on simulation benchmarks and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that PICES achieves speedup by up to 2.3x in wall-clock policy inference time on Jetson Orin and Thor relative to fixed horizon baselines while improving the success rate.

analysis.key_results: 在仿真基准和真实世界操作任务中，相比固定水平基线，PICES在Jetson Orin和Thor上实现最高2.3倍的策略推理时间加速，同时提高了成功率。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出训练无关的PICES方法，在单次策略调用中利用多个噪声样本及其扰动对应项之间的差异，联合选择动作块和执行水平，从而加速VLA推理。
analysis.method: PICES，基于扰动信息的块与执行水平选择：动作专家从多个初始噪声样本及其局部扰动对应项生成批量动作块，利用名义块与对应项之间的动作差异确定候选特定执行水平并选择名义块执行。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出PICES方法，通过联合选择动作块和执行水平，在保证成功率的同时加速VLA模型推理。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接针对VLA模型的推理加速，通过动态调整执行水平减少策略调用次数，属于VLA高效推理的核心研究。

figures.caption: High-level idea of the PICES. (a) Fixed execution horizon generates a nominal action chunk from a single initial noise sample at each policy call and executes a fixed-length actions before replanning. (b) PICES uses multiple initial-noise samples and their perturbations to determine execution horizon of nominal action chunk. Our method reduces the number of policy calls required to complete the same episode, from four to two in the illustrated example. (c) Success rate versus speedup comparison across methods, showing that PICES achieves wall-clock inference time speedup while preserving success rate.
figures.label: Figure 1

papers.abstract: Embodied visual tracking requires a robot to identify a designated target from visual observations and control its own motion to follow that target through an environment. Following an isolated person is a comparatively simple demonstration of embodied visual tracking, but following the intended person among distractors remains challenging. Existing methods exhibit a substantial drop in success from single-target to distractor tracking, motivating a focus on the shared spaces that person-following robots must navigate. We present VLX-GO, a vision-language waypoint policy built around the hypothesis that visual and language representations should be aligned before tracking-specific motion is learned. The policy combines complementary frozen visual encoders, multiscale temporal context, a transformer backbone, and a lightweight head for robot-centric waypoint prediction. Its training progresses through vision--language alignment, multimodal reasoning mid-training, and tracking specialization on 19,532 oracle episodes. Compared with 41.54% distractor-tracking success for our earlier OmTrackVLA model, the complete multi-stage recipe achieves 55.80%. We then explore on-policy refinement using filtered oracle labels for states visited by the policy. This preliminary study adds 2.42 percentage points of distractor-tracking success, reaching 58.22%, while reducing collision rate by 1.99 pts. The final policy records the highest distractor- and ambiguous-tracking success rates among the compared methods. These results support staged multimodal learning as a promising direction for tracking among distractors and motivate further study of on-policy refinement for person following in shared spaces. Code is available at https://github.com/om-ai-lab/VLX-Go.

analysis.key_results: 在干扰跟踪成功率上，完整多阶段训练达到55.80%（基线OmTrackVLA为41.54%），在线精化后进一步提高到58.22%，碰撞率降低1.99个百分点，在对比方法中取得了最高的干扰和模糊跟踪成功率。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出VLX-Go，一个多阶段训练的视觉-语言航点策略，用于在干扰人群中鲁棒地跟踪指定人员，并通过在线策略精化进一步提升性能。
analysis.method: 结合冻结视觉编码器、多尺度时序上下文、Transformer主干和轻量级航点预测头；训练依次进行视觉-语言对齐、多模态推理微调和跟踪任务专业化，并使用过滤的预言机标签进行在线策略精化。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种视觉-语言航点策略VLX-Go，通过多阶段学习（视觉-语言对齐、多模态推理、跟踪专业化）和在线策略精化，提升有人环境中人员跟随的鲁棒性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接研究视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在具身跟踪任务中的应用，与VLA主题核心相关；未涉及世界模型（WAM）。

figures.caption: VLX-Go architecture and training workflow. (A) Frozen DINOv3 and SigLIP features are concatenated and pooled into 188 visual tokens: 31 × ( 2 × 2 ) 31\times(2\times 2) for history and 8 × 8 8\times 8 for the current frame. A vision–language adapter projects these features into a transformer backbone; temporal/view indicators, instruction tokens, and a learnable action query complete the input. A three-layer MLP decodes the action state into eight robot-centric waypoints. (B) Three offline stages train the adapter, then the backbone and adapter, and finally the backbone, adapter, and waypoint head. (C) DAgger collects policy rollouts, labels visited states with the oracle, filters the labels, and fine-tunes on aggregated rollouts and demonstrations. The updated policy supplies the next round of rollouts. Visual encoders remain frozen throughout. Scene and robot images are illustrative.
figures.label: Figure 1

papers.abstract: Speculative Decoding (SD) has demonstrated its efficacy in accelerating large language model inference, but for Vision-Language Models (VLMs), the diverse input modalities make it difficult for a small trained drafter to achieve consistently high throughput. Self-speculative decoding reuses parts of the target model as a drafter which retains the multi-modal capability of the VLMs, yet its efficiency depends on choosing a suitable draft configuration for each prompt. We propose Single-Peak SPeculative decoding (SP$^2$ec), a training-free bandit algorithm that adapts the draft configuration during generation. SP$^2$ec exploits the single-peak throughput pattern observed in existing self-speculative methods, including SWIFT, KnapSpec, SpecVLM, and our simple cosSim. Our algorithmic design explicitly minimizes a novel notion of wall-time regret for each given query, corresponding to the empirical wall-time latency. Theoretical guarantees on the wall-time regret show that SP$^2$ec can exploit the optimal draft configuration, with negligible exploration cost. Extensive experiments on Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct and LLaVA-NeXT-Mistral-7B across visual and textual tasks show consistent improvements of up to 11% over the original self-speculative methods, demonstrating the wide applicability of the proposed SP$^2$ec algorithm.

analysis.key_results: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct和LLaVA-NeXT-Mistral-7B上跨视觉和文本任务，相比原始自推测方法一致提升高达11%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出SP²ec（Single-Peak SPeculative decoding），一种免训练的bandit算法，在自推测解码中自适应调整草稿配置，并理论保证墙钟时间遗憾（wall-time regret）最小化。
analysis.method: 利用自推测方法中观察到的单峰吞吐模式，采用bandit算法动态选择草稿配置，显式最小化每个查询的墙钟时间遗憾。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出SP²ec，一种免训练的自适应bandit算法，在自推测解码中动态调整草稿配置以加速视觉语言模型推理。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文聚焦视觉语言模型的推测解码加速，不直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人动作-世界建模。但该自适应推测解码方法对具身模型的推理效率优化具有潜在借鉴价值。

papers.abstract: World models (WMs) and world-action models (WAMs) focus on future world prediction and executable action generation, respectively. Although these models learn shared physical dynamics and interaction semantics from embodied trajectories, they are typically trained in isolation, which restricts knowledge reuse between prediction and control. The central challenge is therefore to develop a unified learning framework that shares these dynamics while preserving the distinct modeling capabilities required by each paradigm. We propose UniW(A)M, a mixture-of-experts world-(action) model built upon diffusion Transformers that unifies action-conditioned world modeling and diverse WAM variants. Shared experts capture common dynamics, while atomic capability experts are reused across interfaces so that each interface keeps its own conditional pathway. At deployment, a plug-in adaptive interface router (PAIR) learns from a small subset of target-task chunk scenarios to select a suitable WAM interface for each execution chunk, balancing task success and execution efficiency while keeping the backbone frozen. We evaluate UniW(A)M on LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and three real-world manipulation tasks, where it achieves 88.3% average real-world success versus 76.7% for the strongest baseline. On WorldArena, it leads action-conditioned world modeling on all three tasks. AC-WM co-training contributes to action generation on every action interface and PAIR raises OOD success from 63.3% to 76.7%.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0和三个真实世界操作任务上平均真实世界成功率达88.3%（最强基线为76.7%）；在WorldArena中三项动作条件世界建模任务均领先；AC-WM联合训练改善所有动作接口的生成，PAIR将OOD成功率从63.3%提升到76.7%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出UniW(A)M框架，利用混合专家扩散Transformer统一动作条件世界建模和多种WAM变体，并设计PAIR插件式自适应接口路由器，在冻结骨干网络的情况下根据目标任务块场景选择合适接口。
analysis.method: 基于扩散Transformer的混合专家模型，共享专家捕捉通用动态，原子能力专家跨接口复用；部署时通过PAIR从少量目标任务块场景中学习接口选择。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出统一的世界与世界-动作模型混合专家框架UniW(A)M，共享物理动态并通过自适应接口路由平衡任务成功率和执行效率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接聚焦世界-动作模型（WAM），统一世界建模与动作生成，并通过联合训练和自适应路由提升机器人操作中的OOD泛化能力和执行效率，对本站主题高度相关。

figures.caption: Overview of UniW(A)M. The model unifies AC-WM and four WAM paradigms over shared embodied context. AC-WM predicts future video, while action execution adaptively switches among the four WAM paradigms across successive chunks, illustrated by a cloth-folding task.
figures.label: Figure 1

papers.abstract: Time-series analysis is increasingly studied in multimodal settings, yet most benchmarks pair temporal signals with text or with visualizations derived from the same signal. This leaves open whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can integrate time series with real-world visual evidence. We introduce MMTA (multimodal temporal analysis), a benchmark of tri-modal tasks with diverse cross-modal complementarity patterns among time series, text, and vision. MMTA spans nine domains -- robotics, autonomous driving, human action, manufacturing, AR assistance, healthcare, recommendation, finance, and climate -- under video+TS and image+TS layouts, with a 3,524-sample test split covering classification and forecasting. The benchmark standardizes heterogeneous real-world sources into a shared schema with domain-specific prompts, provenance documentation, and success-weighted metrics that penalize both wrong answers and failed generations. Evaluating eight open-source and proprietary MLLMs reveals a shared bottleneck: representing time series as text creates very long token sequences and weakens fine-grained alignment with visual evidence, especially in long-video settings. We then introduce TimeOmni-v, a multimodal LLM extension with a dedicated time-series encoder, temporal positional alignment, modality-aware token layout, and a forecasting head. TimeOmni-v improves long-video classification and time-series inference efficiency, showing that MMTA not only exposes representation and grounding failures but also motivates targeted model design.

analysis.key_results: 八种开源和专有MLLM在MMTA上均存在将时间序列表示为文本导致的长序列和细粒度对齐弱化问题，尤其在长视频设置中；TimeOmni-v改善了长视频分类和时间序列推理效率。
analysis.main_contribution: 构建了覆盖九个领域的三模态时序分析基准MMTA，标准化异构数据并设计成功加权指标；评估八种MLLM揭示时间序列文本化导致的表示与对齐瓶颈；提出TimeOmni-v模型扩展以提升长视频分类和时间序列推理效率。
analysis.method: MMTA基准采用视频+时间序列和图像+时间序列两种布局，统一为共享模式并包含领域特定提示、来源文档和成功加权指标；TimeOmni-v模型引入专用时间序列编码器、时间位置对齐、模态感知标记布局和预测头。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一个包含时间序列、文本和视觉的三模态基准MMTA，用于评估多模态大模型在分类和预测任务上的表现，并发现时间序列文本化导致的表示瓶颈，进而提出TimeOmni-v模型改进长视频分类和时间序列推理效率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作为多模态时序分析建立基准并改进表示效率，涉及机器人等应用领域，但未直接针对VLA或世界模型；其时间序列编码与对齐方法可能对具身模型的时间序列处理有参考价值，但无直接关系。

figures.caption: Overview of MMTA. The benchmark unifies nine real-world domains – Robotics, Autonomous Driving, Human Action, Manufacturing, AR Assistance, Healthcare, Recommendation, Finance, and Climate – under two cross-modal layouts (video + + time series and image + + time series). Vision provides real-world context, text provides semantic context, and time series provides quantitative dynamics; which modality dominates varies across domains.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: Overview of TimeOmni-v. Time series enters the multimodal LLM through a dedicated Chronos-2 encoder branch parallel to the vision encoder. A forecast head is attached for numerical prediction; the standard LM head is used for classification.

papers.abstract: A central goal of vision-language model (VLM) distillation is to transfer both the teacher's language capabilities and its visual understanding. However, existing methods primarily supervise the student's output, leaving visual understanding implicit. Our analysis reveals that a student can match the teacher's answer without relying on the same visual evidence, raising the question: how can we ensure the student responds to the visual information that actually determines the answer? To this end, we propose \textbf{Cross-World On-Policy Distillation (CW-OPD)}, which explicitly supervises the student's response to changes in visual evidence. For each example, CW-OPD constructs two visual worlds that share the question and scene context but differ in answer-critical evidence, yielding different answers. We perform on-policy distillation in both worlds and distill the teacher's cross-world belief transition, encouraging the student to match not only \emph{what} the teacher predicts but also \emph{why} its prediction changes with the evidence. A gradient analysis shows that this term is invariant to errors shared by both worlds and supplies a corrective signal invisible to endpoint matching alone. In this way, CW-OPD makes reliance on the relevant visual evidence an explicit distillation target rather than an implicit consequence of output matching. To diagnose whether a model truly grounds its answers in visual evidence, we introduce CWBench, which measures cross-world consistency via Cross-World Pair Accuracy (CWPA). Experiments on Qwen3.5-4B show that CW-OPD outperforms the strongest baseline by \textbf{1.2} points on average, and the 4B student exceeds DeepSeek-V4.1 (552B) by \textbf{22.4} CWPA points on CWBench. Code is released in https://github.com/baokou-fw2/CWAD.

analysis.key_results: 在Qwen3.5-4B上平均超过最强基线1.2个点，4B学生模型在CWBench上超过DeepSeek-V4.1 (552B) 22.4个CWPA点。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Cross-World On-Policy Distillation (CW-OPD)框架和CWBench基准，使视觉证据依赖成为显式蒸馏目标而非隐式结果。
analysis.method: 构造两个共享问题和场景但答案关键视觉证据不同的视觉世界，进行在线策略蒸馏，并蒸馏教师的跨世界信念转移。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出跨世界在线策略蒸馏方法，通过监督学生对视觉证据变化的响应来显式蒸馏视觉理解，并引入CWBench基准来衡量跨世界一致性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该方法针对通用视觉语言模型蒸馏，未明确涉及机器人动作预测或世界模型，但其跨世界一致性和视觉证据蒸馏思想对视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）和世界模型（WAM）的视觉 grounded 训练具有迁移价值。

papers.title: Distill the Visual Evidence, Not Just the Answer: Cross-World On-Policy Distillation for Vision-Language Models
papers.title_zh: 蒸馏视觉证据而非仅答案：面向视觉语言模型的跨世界在线策略蒸馏

papers.abstract: Generalizable robot manipulation requires predicting how a scene will evolve, identifying where interactions are feasible, and determining how to act. Action-labeled robot videos directly supervise control but are costly and limited in diversity, whereas egocentric human videos capture diverse interactions but lack robot actions and differ in embodiment and appearance. We introduce AffordanceWAM, an affordance-aware generative World Action Model that represents object-centric spatiotemporal affordance through Scalar Affordance and Affordance Heatmap, within the generated future World. This representation grounds visual prediction in task-relevantant objects and interaction regions for action generation, and provides shared interaction targets across human and robot videos. Built on a pretrained video diffusion Transformer, AffordanceWAM uses separately parameterized World and Action Experts, coupled through Masked Joint Self-Attention, to jointly predict future RGB observations, Scalar Affordance fields, Affordance Heatmaps, and continuous robot actions under a unified flow-matching objective. Human videos supervise all three future-World streams, whereas robot trajectories additionally provide action supervision, enabling transfer without human action labels or retargeting. Experiments on RoboCasa, CALVIN ABC$\rightarrow$D, and real-world manipulation demonstrate consistent gains over RGB-only and robot-data-only baselines. Under fixed robot supervision, RoboCasa performance improves monotonically as affordance-annotated human video scales. These results support affordance as an effective interface for both vision-language-action learning and human-to-robot transfer.

analysis.key_results: 在 RoboCasa、CALVIN ABC→D 和真实世界操作上相比仅 RGB 和仅机器人数据的基准取得一致提升；在固定机器人监督下，RoboCasa 性能随带可供性标注的人类视频规模单调提升。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 AffordanceWAM，一种可供性感知的生成式世界动作模型，在统一的流匹配目标下联合预测未来 RGB 观测、标量可供性、可供性热图和连续动作，并实现从人类视频到机器人的跨域迁移。
analysis.method: 在预训练视频扩散 Transformer 上，使用分立参数化的世界专家和动作专家，通过掩码联合自注意力耦合，联合预测未来 RGB、标量可供性字段、可供性热图和连续机器人动作。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出可供性感知的生成式世界动作模型，通过标量可供性字段和可供性热图在预测的未来世界中联合生成机器人动作。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文以世界动作模型（WAM）为核心，通过可供性表示将世界建模与动作生成联合，并利用人类视频进行跨域迁移，与本站 VLA/WAM 和机器人世界建模主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Agent memory systems have demonstrated significant potential in long-term dialogue, personalized assistants, and video understanding. However, continuously accumulated memory introduces substantial storage and retrieval costs during inference. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{MemForest}, a general memory compression framework adaptable to various agent memory systems. Specifically, MemForest partitions historical memory into event-centric units by leveraging global semantic similarity and local temporal continuity. For each unit, it constructs a maximum spanning tree, termed an EventTree, and progressively merges redundant memory nodes by selecting high-weight edges, reducing storage overhead. Furthermore, we introduce an anchor-guided propagation retrieval mechanism that retrieves relevant memory nodes from the temporal neighborhoods of key nodes, improving retrieval accuracy. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of MemForest. Under the unimodal Mem0 framework, MemForest retains \textbf{97.1%} of the original performance while compressing \textbf{50%} of historical memory across three benchmarks (LoCoMo, LongMemEval, and PersonaMem), achieving a \textbf{1.89x} retrieval speedup. Under the multimodal M3-Agent framework, it preserves \textbf{99.7%} of the original performance with a \textbf{50%} compression ratio across two benchmarks (M3-Bench-robot and M3-Bench-web), achieving a \textbf{2.24x} retrieval speedup. \textcolor{RoyalBlue}{\textit{Our code is available at [https://github.com/Celina-love-sweet/MemForest.}}](https://github.com/Celina-love-sweet/MemForest.}})

analysis.key_results: 在 Mem0（三个基准）上压缩 50% 记忆后保持 97.1% 原始性能，检索加速 1.89 倍；在 M3-Agent（含机器人基准）上压缩 50% 后保持 99.7% 性能，检索加速 2.24 倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 MemForest 框架，将历史记忆按事件划分并构建最大生成树（EventTree），通过合并高权重边实现渐进压缩，并引入锚点引导传播检索机制以提高检索精度。
analysis.method: 事件树分区（基于全局语义相似度和局部时间连续性）、渐进合并记忆节点、锚点引导传播检索。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: MemForest 是一种通用智能体记忆压缩框架，通过事件树分区和渐进合并减少存储并加速检索。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作专注于智能体记忆压缩与检索加速，属于高效推理技术，但未直接涉及视觉-语言-动作（VLA）或世界-动作模型（WAM）。其多模态基准 M3-Bench-robot 涉及机器人任务，且摘要类别包含视觉-语言-机器人（composite），但与本站主题的 VLA/WAM 核心方向无直接研究关联。

(b) An example from the LoCoMo benchmark. This example illustrates that memory events exhibit global semantic similarity and local temporal continuity .

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies leverage pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) to guide action generation for robot control. VLMs provide hierarchical visual-semantic representations that evolve across layers, from local visual geometry to abstract, language-aligned semantics; different manipulation tasks may therefore require different mixtures of layer representations. Meanwhile, the action module maintains intermediate representations that evolve throughout action computation and may provide useful information for subsequent decisions. However, existing VLA interfaces offer limited flexibility in representation access: VLM information is exposed through fixed layer assignments for each action layer, while intermediate action states are only propagated implicitly through residual streams without explicit reuse. We introduce LayerRoute, an action-conditioned representation routing interface that enables adaptive access to VLM layers and action representations. The Layer Mixture Router dynamically forms mixtures of cached VLM representations, while Action-State Reread reuses earlier action representations. Across diverse simulation and real-world benchmarks, LayerRoute consistently improves StarVLA-$\pi$ and $\pi_{0.5}$, achieving up to 7.2 gains on LIBERO Long with only 0.31% / 3.87% additional parameters. Ablation studies validate the benefit of action-conditioned layer routing, while routing analyses reveal structured allocation patterns across action layers and task settings.

analysis.key_results: 在多个仿真和真实世界基准上，LayerRoute一致提升StarVLA-π和π0.5，在LIBERO Long上获得最高7.2的提升，且仅增加0.31%/3.87%的额外参数。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入LayerRoute，一个动作条件表示路由接口，包含Layer Mixture Router和Action-State Reread，能自适应访问VLM层和动作表示，在LIBERO Long等基准上提升StarVLA-π和π0.5的性能。
analysis.method: 通过Layer Mixture Router动态形成缓存的VLM表示的混合，并通过Action-State Reread重用早期的动作表示，实现动作条件化的层路由。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出LayerRoute动作条件表示路由接口，动态混合VLM层表示并重用动作状态，以提升VLA策略性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略中表示访问的灵活性进行改进，通过自适应路由VLM层和动作状态，属于VLA策略核心架构的优化，与本站主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: A central goal in robot learning is to move beyond task-specific human data collection toward robots that improve through autonomous interaction. Yet fully autonomous learning remains difficult with current policies: sparse rewards and weak zero-shot exploration often prevent online learning from discovering successful behavior. As a first step towards fully autonomous learning, we propose the minimal-data adaptation regime, in which a pretrained robot policy must learn a new task from as little as one demonstration followed by autonomous online interaction. We establish that, although pretrained policies fail zero-shot on many new tasks, a single demonstration suffices to direct their behavioral prior to coarse task-following behavior, albeit with unreliable performance. From this insight, we isolate the key design principles required to convert coarse task-following into reliable task success. These include (1) the surprising efficacy of pretrained VLA representations to support sample-efficient value learning from online interaction (2) the sufficiency of residual policy learning to learn corrective behavior and (3) the need for careful data-balancing to prevent exploration collapse. As a representative of these principles, we propose MiDAS, a simple offline-to-online RL recipe that combines few-demonstration behavior cloning with value-based residual learning over frozen VLA representations. Across LIBERO and RoboCasa tasks, MiDAS substantially improves performance from single-demonstration initializations, including policies that succeed only rarely, validating the principles highlighted above. On a bimanual YAM platform, starting from a brittle initial policy, MiDAS improves task success after approximately six hours of online interaction.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO和RoboCasa任务中，MiDAS从单次演示初始化大幅提升性能，包括原本很少成功的策略；在双臂YAM平台上，从脆弱的初始策略开始，约六小时在线交互后提高任务成功率。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了最小数据适应设置，并确立了将粗略任务跟随转化为可靠任务成功的关键设计原则：利用预训练VLA表征进行样本高效值学习、残差策略学习以及防止探索崩溃的数据平衡。
analysis.method: MiDAS: 离线到在线强化学习配方，结合少量演示行为克隆与基于冻结VLA表征的值基残差学习。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 论文探讨了预训练VLA策略在单次演示和在线交互的最小数据环境下适应新任务所需的原理，并提出MiDAS方法。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文直接围绕预训练VLA策略的高效适应展开，使用冻结的VLA表征进行值学习和残差策略学习，对VLA在真实机器人上的快速部署和持续学习具有直接方法学价值。

figures.caption: Overview of minimal-data adaptation. A single demonstration is sparse and underdetermined on its own, but pretrained VLA representations turn it into a useful anchor for adaptation. Few-demo behavior cloning narrows the search space to a task-relevant region around the demonstration, and online residual RL then expands local success by learning value-guided corrections on top of the warm-started base policy.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: Performance of different representations in online adaptation. We see that (a) No pretraining, in the form of a Resnet backbone fine-tuned from scratch, collapses; (b) Generic visual pretraining, in the form of frozen DINO features helps, but takes longer to converge; (c) Pretrained VLA representations of π 0.5 \pi_{\text{0.5}} are highly sample efficient, consistent with the hypothesis that action-aligned pretraining can substantially improve the sample efficiency of downstream online adaptation.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.title: What Does It Take For A Generalist Robot Policy To Adapt From Minimal Data?

papers.abstract: Visual navigation policies built on large pretrained models increasingly rely on large cross-embodiment datasets and expressive action-generation mechanisms. In this paper, we ask whether a pretrained Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) can be adapted efficiently for robot navigation by rethinking the representation and construction of navigation actions. We introduce GemNav, a visual navigation policy that represents each robot-local waypoint coordinate as a categorical distribution over discrete metric value bins and soft-decodes it into a continuous coordinate for execution. This probabilistic representation retains likelihood information over alternative coordinate values while providing a compact action space suitable for robot navigation. We further construct training trajectories using metric-distance goal sampling rather than fixed future frame offsets, exposing the policy to varying physical navigation horizons independent of dataset frame rate and robot speed. GemNav is trained on a single 8.7-hour public SCAND dataset, roughly three orders of magnitude smaller than competing cross-embodiment datasets. Extensive offline and closed-loop experiments show improved out-of-distribution generalization over frame-based sampling and substantially more reliable obstacle navigation than a matched continuous regression head. The same policy transfers without per-platform retraining across unseen environments and three physically distinct robot platforms.

analysis.key_results: 在单个8.7小时的SCAND数据集上训练，数据量比竞争性跨具身数据集小约三个数量级；离线实验显示比基于帧采样有更好的分布外泛化性；闭环实验中比匹配的连续回归头具有更可靠的避障导航；同一策略可在未见环境和三种物理异构机器人平台上无需每平台重新训练直接迁移。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种新的导航动作表示方法，将机器人局部航点坐标表示为离散度量值箱上的分类分布，并软化解码为连续坐标；同时采用度量距离目标采样构建训练轨迹，使策略对物理导航距离变化具有不变性。
analysis.method: 将每个机器人局部航点坐标表示为离散度量值箱上的分类分布，并软化解码为连续坐标；使用度量距离目标采样而非固定未来帧偏移构建训练轨迹；采用多模态大语言模型作为策略。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: GemNav提出一种基于多模态大语言模型的视觉导航策略，将机器人局部航点坐标表示为离散度量值箱上的分类分布，并软化解码为连续坐标，从而在紧凑动作空间中保留似然信息。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文属于视觉语言动作（VLA）模型在机器人导航中的应用，通过离散令牌化的动作表示和度量距离目标采样，为VLA在导航任务中的高效训练和泛化提供方法，与本站的VLA主题高度相关。

figures.caption: GemNav overview. Left: Metric-distance-based goal sampling produces eight-waypoint targets over varying physical navigation horizons, reducing dependence on frame rate and demonstrator speed. Center: LoRA adapts the vision and language towers for image, 2D pose, or image+pose goals. A task-specific prediction head jointly produces categorical coordinate distributions for eight waypoints and a navigation state in a single forward pass; soft decoding yields continuous metric waypoints (one coordinate pair shown). Right and bottom: The same checkpoint transfers without per-platform retraining to unseen environments on Spot, ANYmal, and WAVE ROVER, with the latter two being unseen embodiments.

papers.abstract: Can the robot use a plate to cut a cake if no knife is available? Tool use greatly expands robot capabilities, but to use tools creatively beyond their intended functions, the robot faces the challenge of $\textit{open-world affordance grounding}$: select an open-category object to act as a tool and localize its specific region of action. To this end, we introduce GROW$^2$ (GROunding Which and Where), which leverages object parts as a natural abstraction to split the grounding process hierarchically into semantic and geometric levels, thus bypassing the need for data-heavy, end-to-end training. Semantically, GROW$^2$ harnesses the commonsense reasoning of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to parse a natural-language task instruction, select a suitable object as the tool, and identify task-relevant parts on the tool and the target object. Geometrically, vision foundation models then ground the selected parts into precise 3D regions from a single RGB-D image. Experiments on established benchmarks show that GROW$^2$ outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on affordance prediction benchmarks. Further, it achieves zero-shot generalization over open-category objects and outperforms baselines in both simulated and real-world robot tool use experiments.

analysis.key_results: 在既有可供性预测基准上超越最先进基线；在开放类别物体上实现零样本泛化，并在仿真与真实机器人工具使用实验中优于基线。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出GROW²框架，利用物体部件作为抽象，将开放世界可供性定位分层为语义级别（通过VLM选择工具及相关部件）和几何级别（从单张RGB-D图像定位3D区域），无需端到端大量数据训练。
analysis.method: 利用视觉语言模型进行常识推理，解析任务指令、选择合适工具并识别相关部件；再由视觉基础模型将所选部件定位到精确的3D区域。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出GROW²框架，通过层次化地将开放世界可供性定位分解为语义选择与几何定位，使机器人能够创新性地使用工具。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接面向机器人操作中的动作与工具使用，核心是通过视觉语言模型进行任务解析和物体部件定位，属于视觉语言动作（VLA）范畴，对本站的VLA主题有高度相关性，但未涉及世界模型或预测解码等效率主题。

figures.caption: GROW 2 (GROunding Which and Where) decomposes open-world affordance grounding into two levels: (i) semantic selection of an appropriate tool and the task-relevant parts, and (ii) grounding the selected parts into 3D affordance regions. This decomposition enables GROW 2 to leverage a series of foundation models and generalize to open-category objects.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: 3D affordance grounding. Our method consists of two stages: reconstructing and registering an object mesh from a single-view RGB-D observation and rendering the registered mesh from multiple viewpoints, segmenting the selected parts in each view, and fusing the resulting masks into 3D affordance regions.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.abstract: Organizations that cannot send data to a cloud API need to know how well self-hosted open-weight models perform on Text-to-SQL and which inexpensive techniques justify their compute. We benchmark Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct (7B, 14B, 32B) and CodeLlama-Instruct (7B, 13B) self-hosted at 16-bit precision, Llama-3.1-8B and Llama-3.3-70B through an FP8 API, and Qwen2.5-Coder-32B through a second API on the BIRD development split (n = 1534), with one zero-shot prompt and the official execution-accuracy comparison on read-only databases. We ablate lexical and embedding schema linking, execution-guided self-correction and self-consistency, and test every within-model recipe difference with exact McNemar tests, Holm correction over 30 tests and a database-clustered bootstrap. Qwen2.5-Coder reaches 42.6%, 52.0% and 54.9%; CodeLlama-7B and -13B reach 23.7% and 26.3%. Self-correction is the only component with a consistent gain: within a run it adds 1.2 to 4.4 points at 1.1 to 1.9 times the tokens, and it is significant after Holm correction for every model except Llama-3.3-70B. Schema linking never helps significantly; lexical linking costs Llama-3.3-70B 4.2 points, and an embedding linker with higher table recall does not differ detectably from no linking. Self-consistency, run for one model, changed accuracy by at most 0.13 points at about five times the tokens. One API provider dropped spaces next to digits; after a whitespace repair the same model scored 54.5% through the API and 54.9% self-hosted, so an apparent three-point serving gap was mostly this defect. This version corrects six defects of v1, including writable databases, a stricter-than-official metric and a truncated API arm, and withdraws the v1 claim of a quantization penalty of about 13 points; all numbers are re-scored or re-run. Code, per-item predictions and analysis scripts are released.

analysis.key_results: Qwen2.5-Coder达到42.6%、52.0%和54.9%；CodeLlama-7B和-13B分别达到23.7%和26.3%。自纠正是唯一持续有效的技巧，添加1.2到4.4个点，代价为1.1到1.9倍的token。模式链接从未显著帮助；自一致性对精度影响最多0.13个点。修复API提供方的空格缺陷后，同一模型得分54.5%（API）和54.9%（自托管）。
analysis.main_contribution: 在BIRD开发集上对Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct和CodeLlama-Instruct等自托管开源模型进行了系统基准测试，并消融了多种推理技巧，修正了v1版本中的缺陷。
analysis.method: 在16位精度下自托管开源模型，并使用FP8 API对比，采用零样本提示和执行准确率评估，通过McNemar检验和Holm校正进行统计显著性测试。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文在BIRD基准上评估了自托管开源LLM的Text-to-SQL性能，并消融了模式链接、自纠正和自一致性等技巧。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于Text-to-SQL任务的开源LLM评估和技巧消融，与VLA（视觉-语言-动作）和WAM（机器人世界模型）无直接关系。但其涉及的模型量化（FP8 API）和高效推理技巧（自纠正、自一致性）对本站关于模型量化和高效推理的主题具有一定的参考价值。

papers.title: How far do on-premises open LLMs get on Text-to-SQL? A cross-family size and technique frontier on BIRD
papers.title_zh: 本地开源大模型在Text-to-SQL任务上的表现与技巧前沿

papers.abstract: Multi-task robot manipulation policies are challenging to learn from demonstration because traditionally a single network must select among qualitatively different action modes from a multimodal demonstration distribution, conditioned on language and visual context. A wrong mode selection means executing the wrong task or an action infeasible in the scene. Tokenizing continuous actions into a learned discrete codebook separates these modes at the representation level, offering structural advantages for multi-task learning. We propose VQActFlow, a multi-task manipulation policy that tokenizes action chunks and generates code sequences via Variational Flow Matching. VQActFlow maintains an explicit preference over action modes throughout generation. Inference-time guidance acts on this preference to steer mode commitment. We instantiate this with classifier-free guidance over language conditioning, which steers the policy toward the instructed action mode, and a learned codebook critic that supplies a complementary feasibility signal. We evaluate VQActFlow on three platforms: the LIBERO simulation benchmarks, a Unitree G1 humanoid performing whole-body pick-and-place, and an ALOHA-style bimanual platform performing contact-rich tasks. Across these benchmarks, VQActFlow outperforms both continuous and discrete baselines.

analysis.key_results: 在 LIBERO 仿真基准、Unitree G1 人形机器人全身抓取放置以及 ALOHA 式双臂接触丰富任务上，VQActFlow 优于连续和离散基线。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 VQActFlow 多任务操作策略，将动作块量化为离散码本，并通过变分流匹配生成码序列；引入推理时引导，在语言条件上使用无分类器引导，并利用学习到的码本批评器提供可行性信号来引导模式承诺。
analysis.method: 将连续动作块量化为学习到的离散码本，结合变分流匹配生成动作码序列；在推理时通过语言条件上的无分类器引导和码本批评器引导模式选择。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: VQActFlow 通过向量量化动作块并结合变分流匹配生成动作码序列，实现对多任务机器人操作中动作模式的显式引导。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作属于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略学习范畴，通过向量量化动作表示与流匹配生成，在多任务机器人操作中显式建模动作模式，显著提升了策略性能和任务选择性。

figures.caption: VQActFlow framework. Stage 1: a VQ-VAE encoder tokenizes action chunks into discrete codebook indices, and a decoder reconstructs actions from the quantized embeddings. Stage 2: a VFM policy transports Gaussian noise toward codebook embeddings, maintaining an explicit preference over action modes that inference-time guidance steers, CFG toward the instructed task and a codebook critic toward feasible modes.
figures.label: Figure 1

papers.title: VQActFlow: Vector-Quantized Action Mode Steering for Multi-Task Robot Manipulation
papers.title_zh: VQActFlow：面向多任务机器人操作的向量量化动作模式引导

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models leverage the rich world knowledge of pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) to enable instruction-following robotic manipulation. However, the structural mismatch between VLM semantic spaces and embodied control policies often hinders the learning of precise perception-action mappings. To address this challenge, we propose AffordanceVLA, a scalable, unified framework that introduces structured affordance learning as a task-oriented and object-centric intermediate representation to establish a more precise and robust perception-action mapping. Specifically, we progressively model manipulation priors through three complementary components - Which2Act, Where2Act, and How2Act - which jointly produce spatially grounded, semantically conditioned, and action-coupled intermediate representations, thereby naturally bridging vision, language, and action. We integrate these modules into a Mixture-of-Transformer (MoT) architecture and adopt a three-stage progressive training curriculum that leverages 8.8M affordance-centric grounding and pointing samples, translating scalable vision-language supervision into improved robotic manipulation. To overcome the scarcity of dense affordance labels in robotic datasets, we also develop a robust automated data augmentation pipeline. Extensive experiments on ID & OOD simulation and real-world demonstrate that AffordanceVLA outperforms strong VLA baselines across diverse manipulation scenarios, validating structured affordance learning as a scalable and robust bridge that integrates multi-source vision-language supervision while connecting pretrained VLM semantics to embodied robot control.

analysis.key_results: 在 ID 和 OOD 仿真及真实世界的大量实验中，AffordanceVLA 在多种操作场景下优于强 VLA 基线。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 AffordanceVLA 框架，通过 Which2Act、Where2Act、How2Act 三个互补模块引入结构化可供性学习，并采用 Mixture-of-Transformer 架构和三阶段渐进训练课程，将大规模视觉-语言监督转化为改进的机器人操作能力。
analysis.method: 通过三个互补组件（Which2Act、Where2Act、How2Act）建模操作先验，生成空间接地、语义条件和动作耦合的中间表示；采用 Mixture-of-Transformer 架构和三阶段渐进训练；利用 8.8M 可供性为中心的接地和指向样本进行训练；开发自动化数据增强流程以克服机器人数据集中密集可供性标签稀缺的问题。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: AffordanceVLA 提出结构化可供性学习框架，以任务导向、对象中心的中间表示桥接视觉、语言与动作，从而提升机器人操作策略的精确性和鲁棒性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接针对 VLA 模型，旨在解决 VLM 语义空间与具体控制策略之间的结构失配问题，通过结构化可供性学习建立更精确的感知-动作映射，与本站主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown promise for robotic manipulation, yet most existing policies operate reactively by directly regressing actions from current observations, without explicitly modeling future dynamics. This limits their ability to generalize under out-of-distribution perturbations. To address this issue, we propose ELAN4D, an embodiment-centric, 4D-aware training framework that enhances VLA policies with future robot keypoint tracks as predictive spatio-temporal supervision. Using only forward kinematics from proprioceptive states, we derive 3D displacement tracks of robot keypoints, such as joints and the end-effector, with negligible preprocess cost. These tracks provide metric and compact supervision without requiring external trackers or reconstruction. A plug-and-play auxiliary branch with a lightweight track decoder injects this 4D signal into the action expert while preserving the pretrained vision-language backbone through gradient isolation. The track decoder is discarded during inference, leaving the base policy interface unchanged. Extensive experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin2.0 and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that ELAN4D consistently improves over strong VLA baselines, achieving the best overall performance and substantial gains under out-of-distribution perturbations, including camera, background, and layout shifts. These results highlight the effectiveness of embodiment-centric 4D supervision for building more robust and generalizable manipulation policies.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin2.0和真实世界操作任务上的大量实验表明，ELAN4D持续改进强VLA基线，实现最佳整体性能，并在相机、背景和布局变化等分布外扰动下取得显著增益。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出ELAN4D，一个实施例中心、4D感知的训练框架，通过即插即用的辅助分支以未来机器人关键点轨迹作为额外监督，提升VLA策略的鲁棒性和泛化性。
analysis.method: 利用前向运动学从本体感知状态推导机器人关键点的3D位移轨迹，通过轻量级轨迹解码器将4D信号注入动作专家，同时通过梯度隔离保留预训练的视觉-语言骨干，推理时丢弃轨迹解码器。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出ELAN4D框架，通过从本体感知状态推导的未来机器人关键点3D位移轨迹作为预测性时空监督，增强VLA策略的泛化能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接针对VLA模型，通过实施例中心的4D监督（预测未来机器人关键点轨迹）隐式建模未来动态，增强策略对分布偏移的鲁棒性，与机器人操作与世界建模密切相关。

papers.abstract: Understanding how Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models transform multimodal knowledge into embodied control remains an open challenge. We present VLA-Trace, a progressive diagnostic framework that analyzes VLA models through a unified evidence chain from representation dynamics to causal control attribution and behavioral manifestation. It specifically combines cross-modal and checkpoint-drift centered kernel alignment (CKA) to trace representation evolution, attention knockout interventions to identify modality-specific control pathways, and rollout-level behavioral probes to examine grounding, shortcut dependence, and semantic following. Experiments on $\pi_{0.5}$ and OpenVLA reveal three key findings. First, the two models exhibit distinct modality-specific adaptation dynamics during VLA finetuning. Second, they rely on different multimodal routing strategies and layer-wise dependencies during action decoding. Third, although VLA policies excel at visually grounded trajectory generation, they remain limited in fine-grained semantic following. These findings highlight future directions for representation-preserving adaptation, causal VLA circuits, and compositional semantic control.

analysis.key_results: 在π0.5和OpenVLA上的实验发现：两者在VLA微调期间有不同的模态特定适应动态；在动作解码中依赖不同的多模态路由策略和层级依赖；虽然视觉grounding轨迹生成出色，但细粒度语义遵循仍受限。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了一个渐进式诊断框架VLA-Trace，结合跨模态与checkpoint-drift CKA、注意力敲除干预和rollout行为探针，以统一证据链分析VLA模型。
analysis.method: 结合跨模态和checkpoint-drift centered kernel alignment (CKA)追踪表征演化，使用注意力敲除干预识别模态特定控制通路，并通过rollout-level行为探针检验grounding、捷径依赖和语义遵循。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出VLA-Trace诊断框架，通过表征动态、因果归因和行为探针系统分析VLA模型。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文直接研究VLA模型，通过表征和行为追踪诊断其内部机制，对理解VLA模型如何处理多模态知识并生成动作具有重要意义，属于核心主题。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong potential for general-purpose robotic manipulation, yet they still struggle to generalize to unseen tasks that necessitate transferring relevant experience across objects, scenes, and action patterns. This paper proposes VLA-Pro, a plug-and-play framework designed to enhance cross-task generalization by storing task-relevant procedural memories at training time and transferring these memories during inference. Specifically, VLA-Pro stores task-specific LoRA adapters as parameterized procedural memories during training. At inference time, VLA-Pro retrieves relevant procedural memories based on the current multi-modal context and dynamically fuses these memories for generating the current action chunk. Experiments on RoboTwin, RLBench, and real-world manipulation tasks show that VLA-Pro consistently improves cross-task generalization across multiple backbones, achieving up to a 207% relative improvement in simulation and increasing real-world success rate from 5.8% to 65.0%. These results suggest that procedural memory retrieval and adaptation provide an effective mechanism for transferring manipulation experience to novel tasks while preserving modularity and execution stability.

analysis.key_results: 在RoboTwin、RLBench及真实世界操作任务上，VLA-Pro在多种骨干网络下一致提升跨任务泛化，仿真中相对提升最高207%，真实世界成功率从5.8%提升至65.0%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种即插即用的VLA-Pro框架，通过存储任务相关程序记忆并在推理时动态检索与融合，显著提升VLA模型在未见任务上的跨任务泛化性能。
analysis.method: 训练时将任务特定LoRA适配器存储为参数化程序记忆；推理时根据多模态上下文检索相关程序记忆并动态融合生成当前动作块。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出VLA-Pro框架，通过训练时存储任务特定LoRA适配器作为程序记忆并在推理时检索融合，提升视觉-语言-动作模型跨任务泛化能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文直接聚焦于VLA模型的跨任务泛化，属于本站核心主题；提出的程序记忆检索与迁移机制对VLA策略学习具有直接参考价值。

papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have made substantial progress in egocentric video understanding, but their ability to reason cooperatively from multiple embodied viewpoints remains largely unexplored. We study this problem through multi-robot cooperative dynamic spatial reasoning, where a model must answer spatial, temporal, visibility, and coordination questions by integrating synchronized egocentric videos from a team of moving robots. To support this setting, we introduce CoopSR, the first benchmark for this task, together with EgoTeam, a multi-robot egocentric QA dataset. EgoTeam contains 114,227 QA pairs spanning 19 question types, four difficulty tiers, and three team sizes in Habitat and iGibson, along with a real-world test set of around 2,326 QAs collected using two quadruped robots. We further propose SG-CoR (Spectral and Geometry-Aware Cooperative Reasoner), an MLLM framework for fine-grained cooperative spatial reasoning. SG-CoR combines dynamics-aware multi-robot frame sampling, spectral- and geometric-guided view fusion, and geometry- and motion-informed prompt distillation, enabling the model to benefit from privileged robot-pose supervision during training while requiring only egocentric videos at test time. Across 22 MLLM baselines, SG-CoR consistently improves cooperative reasoning, outperforming the strongest fine-tuned baseline by +3.87% on Habitat and +7.12% on iGibson. It also shows stronger generalization to unseen team sizes and real-world robot tests. Code can be found at https://github.com/KPeng9510/seeing-together.git.

analysis.key_results: SG-CoR在22个多模态大语言模型基线上一致提升协作推理性能，在Habitat上优于最强微调基线+3.87%，在iGibson上优于+7.12%，并展现出对未见团队规模和真实世界机器人测试更强的泛化能力。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出首个多机器人协作空间推理基准CoopSR、多机器人自我中心问答数据集EgoTeam，以及SG-CoR多模态大语言模型框架。
analysis.method: SG-CoR框架结合动态感知的多机器人帧采样、基于谱与几何的视角融合，以及几何与运动信息引导的提示蒸馏。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该工作引入首个多机器人协作动态空间推理基准CoopSR和数据集EgoTeam，并提出SG-CoR框架以提升多模态大语言模型在协作空间推理任务上的表现。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作聚焦多机器人自我中心视频的空间推理与协作，属于具身智能和视觉-语言-动作领域，其方法对多智能体下的VLA模型、机器人策略学习以及协作世界理解具有直接参考价值。

papers.abstract: Biological laboratory automation can reduce repetitive manual work and improve reproducibility, but reliable embodied execution in wet-lab environments remains challenging. Protocols are often unstructured, labware is frequently transparent or reflective, and multi-step procedures require state-aware execution beyond one-shot instruction following. Existing robotic systems often rely on costly hardware, fixed workflows, dedicated instruments, or robotics-oriented interfaces. Here, we introduce BioProVLA-Agent, an affordable, protocol-driven, vision-enhanced embodied multi-agent system enabled by Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for biological manipulation. The system uses protocols as the task interface and integrates protocol parsing, visual state verification, and embodied execution in a closed-loop workflow. A Tailored LLM Protocol Agent converts protocols into verifiable subtasks; a VLM-RAG Verification Agent assesses readiness and completion using observations, robot states, retrieved knowledge, and success/failure examples; and a VLA Embodied Agent executes verified subtasks through a lightweight policy. To improve robustness under wet-lab visual perturbations, we develop AugSmolVLA, an online augmentation strategy targeting transparent labware, reflections, illumination shifts, and overexposure. We evaluate the system on a hierarchical benchmark covering 15 atomic tasks, 6 composite workflows, and 3 bimanual tasks, including tube loading, sorting, waste disposal, cap twisting, and liquid pouring. Across normal and high-exposure settings, AugSmolVLA improves execution stability over ACT, X-VLA, and the original SmolVLA, especially for precise placement, transparent-object manipulation, composite workflows, and visually degraded scenes. These results suggest a practical route toward accessible, protocol-centered, and verification-capable embodied AI for biological manipulation.

analysis.key_results: 在15项原子任务、6项组合工作流和3项双手任务的基准测试中，AugSmolVLA在正常和高曝光条件下均优于ACT、X-VLA和原始SmolVLA，尤其在精确放置、透明物体操作、组合工作流和视觉退化场景。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出BioProVLA-Agent系统，集成协议解析、视觉状态验证和具身执行，并开发AugSmolVLA在线增强策略提升湿实验室视觉扰动下的执行稳定性。
analysis.method: 系统由LLM协议代理、VLM-RAG验证代理和VLA具身代理组成，通过轻量级策略执行经验证的子任务；AugSmolVLA针对透明器皿、反射、光照变化和过曝进行在线增强。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一个由VLA模型驱动的经济型、协议驱动、视觉增强的具身多智能体系统，用于生物实验室操作，并开发了在线增强策略AugSmolVLA以提升在视觉干扰下的鲁棒性。

papers.abstract: Distributed training of large neural networks is bottlenecked by full-precision gradient communication and by coordinatewise optimizers that ignore the matrix structure of weight tensors. We propose Sign-Muon, a 1-bit, matrix-aware optimizer that combines majority-vote sign aggregation from signSGD with the polar-step framework of Muon. Each worker forms a Muon-style direction by taking the polar factor of its momentum via a Newton--Schulz iteration, transmits only the entrywise signs, and aggregates by majority vote; an optional local polar step further enforces orthogonality at no extra communication cost. Under spectral-norm smoothness and bounded-variance stochastic gradients, the spectral-norm normalized sign step yields an $\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{T})$ nonconvex rate for an $\ell_1$-based stationarity measure. With unimodal symmetric noise, majority vote across $M$ workers cuts the stochastic term by $1/\sqrt{M}$, matching signSGD. In the $\alpha$-$\beta$ model, distributed Sign-Muon needs only one integer sum-allreduce per iteration; all orthogonalization is local, giving a $32\times$ bandwidth reduction over float32 ($4\times$ for int8). Across 330 CIFAR-10/ResNet-50 configurations Sign-Muon attains the best validation accuracy (92.15\%); its 4-GPU majority-vote variant reaches 92.02\% with 37\% less training time at matched effective batch. On nanoGPT, Sign-Muon achieves lower perplexity and better anytime performance than other sign-based baselines, with favorable weak-scaling up to 16 GPUs.

analysis.key_results: 在语义噪声下，分布式 Sign-Muon 每迭代仅需一次整数 sum-allreduce，带宽比 float32 减少 32 倍（int8 为 4 倍）；在 330 个 CIFAR-10/ResNet-50 配置中达到最佳验证精度 92.15%，4-GPU 多数投票变体达到 92.02% 且训练时间减少 37%；在 nanoGPT 上优于其他基于符号的基线，并在最多 16 个 GPU 上表现出良好的弱扩展性。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 Sign-Muon：一种 1 比特、矩阵感知的分布式优化器，结合 signSGD 的多数投票符号聚合与 Muon 的极步框架，实现通信高效训练。
analysis.method: 每个 worker 通过 Newton-Schulz 迭代对动量取极因子，仅传输元素符号并按多数投票聚合；可选局部极步进一步施加正交性。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出 Sign-Muon，一种结合符号聚合和 Muon 极步框架的 1 比特矩阵感知分布式优化算法，显著降低通信带宽并保持收敛性能。

papers.abstract: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) aims to enable an embodied agent to follow natural-language instructions and navigate to a target location in unseen 3D environments. We argue that adapting VLMs to VLN requires endowing them with two complementary capabilities for acquiring such awareness, namely backward action reasoning (why) and forward transition prediction~(how). Based on this insight, we propose SpaAct, a simple yet effective training framework that activates the dynamic spatial awareness in VLMs. Specifically, SpaAct introduces two spatial activation tasks: Action Retrospection, which asks the model to infer the executed action sequence from visual transitions, and Future Frame Selection, which forces the model to predict the visual transitions conditioned on history and action. These two objectives provide lightweight supervision on both backward action reasoning and forward transition prediction, encouraging the model to build dynamic spatial awareness in a VLM-friendly way. To further stabilize adaptation, we design TriPA, a Tri-factor Progressive Adaptive curriculum learning method that organizes training samples from easy to hard, allowing the model to gradually acquire navigation skills from basic locomotion to long-horizon reasoning. Experiments on standard VLN-CE benchmarks show that SpaAct consistently improves VLM-based navigation and achieves state-of-the-art performance. We will release the code and models to support future research.

analysis.key_results: 在标准VLN-CE基准上，SpaAct持续提升基于VLM的导航性能并达到最先进水平。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出SpaAct训练框架，引入行动回溯和未来帧选择两个空间激活任务，并设计TriPA课程学习方法，以激活VLM的动态空间感知能力。
analysis.method: SpaAct框架，包括行动回溯（从视觉变化推断已执行动作序列）和未来帧选择（基于历史和动作预测视觉变化）两个任务，以及TriPA三因素渐进自适应课程学习方法。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出SpaAct训练框架，通过后向动作推理和前向过渡预测激活VLM的动态空间感知，提升视觉-语言导航性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作涉及视觉-语言模型与机器人导航任务的适配，属于VLA相关研究，但聚焦于VLN任务而非通用机器人世界模型或动作世界模型；其空间激活训练方法对VLA中的空间感知与动作推理有一定参考价值。

papers.abstract: Image-goal navigation steers an agent to a target location specified by an image in unseen environments. Existing methods primarily handle this task by learning an end-to-end navigation policy, which compares the similarities of target and observation images and directly predicts the actions. However, when the target is distant or lies in another room, such methods fail to extract informative visual cues, leading the agent to wander around. Motivated by the human cognitive principle that deliberate, high-level reasoning guides fast, reactive execution in complex tasks, we propose Hierarchical Reasoning Navigation (HRNav), a framework that decomposes image-goal navigation into high-level planning and low-level execution. In high-level planning, a vision-language model is trained on a self-collected dataset to generate a short-horizon plan, such as whether the agent should walk through the door or down the hallway. This downgrades the difficulty of the long-horizon task, making it more amenable to the execution part. In low-level execution, an online reinforcement learning policy is utilized to decide actions conditioned on the short-horizon plan. We also devise a novel Wandering Suppression Penalty (WSP) to further reduce the wandering problem. Together, these components form a hierarchical framework for Image-Goal Navigation. Extensive experiments in both simulation and real-world environments demonstrate the superiority of our method.

analysis.key_results: 仿真和真实环境实验表明方法优于现有技术。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出分层推理导航框架HRNav，将图像目标导航分解为高层规划与低层执行，并设计Wandering Suppression Penalty减少徘徊。
analysis.method: 高层使用基于自采数据集训练的视觉语言模型生成短时规划，低层使用在线强化学习策略根据规划输出动作，并加入Wandering Suppression Penalty。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出HRNav框架，将图像目标导航分解为高层规划与低层执行，并引入WSP惩罚抑制徘徊。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for autonomous driving receive navigation commands and hazard notices as disconnected text fragments, forcing the model to discover on its own which environmental constraints are relevant to the current maneuver. We introduce Causal Scene Narration (CSN), which restructures VLA text inputs through intent-constraint alignment, quantitative grounding, and structured separation at inference time with zero GPU cost. To test CSN across different model states and safety layers, we evaluate it alongside training-time preference alignment (PL-DPO-NLL) and runtime supervision as experimental conditions. A multi-town CARLA evaluation (16 routes, 8 towns, N=5, 95% bootstrap CIs) shows that CSN yields relative improvements in CARLA Driving Score (DS, route completion weighted by infraction penalty) of +31.1% on original LMDrive and +24.5% on the PL-DPO-NLL variant. A controlled ablation separating information content from text organization reveals that information content carries most of CSN's gain across both model weights (+6.17 DS on original LMDrive; +6.88 DS on PL-DPO-NLL). While causal structure accounts for an estimated 39.1% (95% CI [6.6%, 71.4%]) of the gain on original LMDrive versus 13.5% on PL-DPO-NLL, the structural share on the aligned model and the cross-configuration asymmetry remain statistically inconclusive at N=5 due to wide bootstrap intervals. A perception noise ablation further confirms that CSN's benefit survives distance errors up to +/-5 m, speed noise up to +/-30%, and 20% actor miss rates. Finally, we report a negative result on combining CSN with runtime supervision: a naive direction-conflict monitor never fires on this benchmark and, when paired with CSN, degrades DS via passive control clamping that truncates CSN-guided evasive maneuvers. Code is available at https://github.com/LiYun0607/CausalSceneNarration.

analysis.key_results: 在CARLA多城镇评估中，CSN将LMDrive驾驶得分提高31.1%，将PL-DPO-NLL变体提高24.5%；内容信息是主要增益来源，结构作用因置信区间宽而不确定；感知噪声下鲁棒；与运行时监督的简单组合产生负面结果。
analysis.limitations: 结构增益在PL-DPO-NLL上不显著；结合运行时监督的简单方向冲突监控器导致性能下降；样本量N=5导致统计功效有限。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出因果场景叙述（CSN），通过意图-约束对齐、量化 grounding 和结构化分离，在推理时重构VLA模型的文本输入，无需训练或GPU成本。
analysis.method: CSN将导航命令和危险提示重构为因果结构的文本，并在推理时使用；与训练时偏好对齐（PL-DPO-NLL）和运行时监督结合评估。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出因果场景叙述（CSN），在推理时零GPU成本重构VLA模型的文本输入，以提升自动驾驶性能。

papers.abstract: For neural surrogates of time-dependent partial differential equations (PDEs), storage and memory budgets require training data to be obtained by coarsening and quantizing very-high-resolution numerical simulations. Fine-scale information can thus be lost before it reaches the model. We analyze this effect in periodic incompressible Navier-Stokes: quantization spreads error evenly over the retained modes, so the finest retained band, which holds the least energy, is the most corrupted, and velocity and vorticity are distorted differently under the same operator. Building on this analysis, we propose Derived-Field Optimization (DerivOpt), which chooses which primitive and derived fields to carry from a supplied library, and how many bits each receives, by exactly minimizing a closed-form posterior risk under a calibrated channel model. This optimization problem always has an optimum and requires no knowledge of the governing equation. On PDEBench, DerivOpt not only lowers the pooled rollout nRMSE but also substantially reduces the fine-band error. These gains are already present in the predictor-free input state and add to those of a multiscale architecture. Which fields are carried, and at what precision, is thus an optimizable design variable upstream of the predictor that determines how much information a fixed budget leaves recoverable.

analysis.key_results: 在PDEBench上，DerivOpt降低了汇集的滚动nRMSE，并显著减少了精细频段误差；这些增益已在无预测器的输入状态中存在，且与多尺度架构的增益叠加。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Derived-Field Optimization (DerivOpt)方法，通过最小化一个闭式后验风险，从可用场库中选择需要携带的原始和派生场并确定各场的量化比特数，无需了解控制方程。
analysis.method: DerivOpt在给定比特预算下，基于校准的信道模型，对原始场和派生场的二进制量化进行联合优化，选择最优场集合并分配比特数，以最小化后验风险。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该文分析并优化了在量化与粗化数据条件下训练神经PDE代理时，选择原始场和派生场及其比特分配的策略，以减少信息损失并提升模型精度。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 虽然本文针对时间依赖PDE的神经代理的数据量化与存储优化，但DerivOpt的核心思想（通过优化输入场的选择与精度分配来最大化信息保留）可迁移到VLA/WAM中处理多模态传感器输入和世界模型状态的压缩与预算分配，具有方法层面的参考价值。

papers.title: Derived Fields Increase the Recoverable Information in Budgeted Neural PDE Surrogate

papers.abstract: We introduce Latent-WAM, an efficient end-to-end autonomous driving framework that achieves strong trajectory planning through spatially-aware and dynamics-informed latent world representations. Existing world-model-based planners suffer from inadequately compressed representations, limited spatial understanding, and underutilized temporal dynamics, resulting in sub-optimal planning under constrained data and compute budgets. Latent-WAM addresses these limitations with two core modules: a Spatial-Aware Compressive World Encoder (SCWE) that distills geometric knowledge from a foundation model and compresses multi-view images into compact scene tokens via learnable queries, and a Dynamic Latent World Model (DLWM) that employs a causal Transformer to autoregressively predict future world status conditioned on historical visual and ego status representations. Extensive experiments on NAVSIM v2 and HUGSIM demonstrate new state-of-the-art results: 89.3 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2 and 28.9 HD-Score on HUGSIM, surpassing the best prior perception-free method by 3.2 EPDMS with significantly less training data and a compact 104M-parameter model. The code and model weights have been open-sourced at https://github.com/yukki555/Latent-WAM.

analysis.key_results: NAVSIM v2上89.3 EPDMS，HUGSIM上28.9 HD-Score，超越最佳先前感知自由方法3.2 EPDMS，使用显著更少的训练数据和104M参数模型。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Latent-WAM框架，结合空间感知压缩世界编码器和动态潜在世界模型，在NAVSIM v2和HUGSIM上取得新SOTA，以104M参数和更少训练数据超越先前最佳感知自由方法。
analysis.method: 空间感知压缩世界编码器（SCWE）蒸馏基础模型几何知识，将多视图图像压缩为紧凑场景token；动态潜在世界模型（DLWM）使用因果Transformer自回归预测未来世界状态。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出Latent-WAM，通过空间感知压缩世界编码器和动态潜在世界模型，在紧凑模型与少数据下实现端到端自动驾驶的先进轨迹规划。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文以潜在世界动作建模（WAM）为核心，通过压缩世界表示和动态预测实现自动驾驶规划，与本站WAM主题高度相关，并关注数据和计算效率。

figures.caption: Performance vs. training data scale on NAVSIM v2. Bubble size indicates model parameters. World4Drive is marked separately as it employs an additional ViT-L depth estimator.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: Overall architecture of Latent-WAM. The framework consists of three modules: (1) Spatial-Aware Compressive World Encoder (SCWE) compresses images into compact scene tokens with geometric distillation for spatial understanding; (2) Dynamic Latent World Model (DLWM) predicts future world states from historical scene representations and ego status; (3) Trajectory Decoder forecasts 4-second trajectories. SCWE and DLWM jointly optimize the vision backbone. Notably, DLWM is used only during training and discarded at inference, while its prediction objective enriches the vision backbone, enabling the trajectory decoder to directly use SCWE representations for planning.

papers.abstract: A fine-tuned Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policy can easily place the alphabet soup in the basket on command, just as it saw during fine-tuning. However, if the basket is shifted five centimeters to the left, it drops the soup off the table. We developed an interpretability pipeline to investigate what such a policy is computing. Injecting task A's activations into the action expert while the policy looks at task B's scene makes pi0.5 execute task A's motor trajectory in 99.6\% of episodes ($n{=}1{,}968$). The injected program is bound to absolute workspace coordinates and ignores the visible scene, which provides a mechanistic account of the perturbation brittleness that concurrent benchmarks report. The binding holds on a physical UR10e: directed replay redirects the commanded task in 26/26 rollouts in one direction and 18/26 in the other, with no-injection and random-direction controls at the floor, and once the source object is moved 10--15\,cm the arm grasps and releases at the recorded coordinates in 50/50 trials, picking up the wrong block when one sits there and closing on empty air when none does. Applying the same interventions to six VLAs on LIBERO, MetaWorld, SimplerEnv, and ALOHA over 420{,}000+ rollouts yields three further findings: every architecture encodes the instruction, and four of the five weight it below vision whenever the scene alone identifies the goal; under the standard replacement write-back the SAE pooling that preserves behavior is architecture-specific (pi0.5 per-token, X-VLA mean-pool, SmolVLA indifferent), and goal selection and motor generation separate into VLM and expert pathways wherever the two are distinguishable. We release \textbf{Action Atlas} (https://action-atlas.com), an interactive platform covering all 520+ trained SAEs, 79 identified concepts, and the scored UR10e rollouts. Code: https://github.com/CWRU-AISM/action-atlas

analysis.key_results: 注入导致pi0.5在99.6%的回合中执行任务A的运动轨迹；在物理UR10e上，定向重放分别以26/26和18/26的成功率重定向任务；将源物体移动10-15厘米后，机械臂在50/50试验中在记录的坐标处抓取和释放；所有架构都编码指令，五个中的四个在场景单独识别目标时将视觉权重低于视觉；SAE池化保留行为是架构特定的；目标选择和运动生成分离为VLM和专家路径。
analysis.main_contribution: 开发了一个可解释性流程，用于探究VLA策略的计算机制，并发布Action Atlas平台，涵盖520多个SAE、79个识别的概念以及UR10e评分实验。
analysis.method: 通过将任务A的激活注入动作专家，同时让策略观察任务B的场景，来研究VLA策略；在LIBERO、MetaWorld、SimplerEnv和ALOHA上对六个VLA进行干预。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该研究通过可解释性流程揭示了微调后的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略将任务绑定到绝对工作空间坐标，而非视觉场景，从而解释了其对扰动的脆弱性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该研究直接针对VLA模型，深入解析其内部表征与计算机制，揭示了动作生成对绝对坐标的依赖，对机器人操作模型的鲁棒性和可解释性具有重要价值。
